# Outlaw Rogue Enchants & Consumables - Midnight

[By JustGuy](https://www.wowhead.com/author/JustGuy)
Updated:
2026/02/25

Consumables are an important aspect of high-level content in WoW, such as raids and Mythic+ dungeons. They provide additional ways for players to improve and customize their stats outside of gear.

In this guide, we will explain the best gems, flasks, potions, and enchants to use for Outlaw Rogue in **Midnight Season 1**, as well as cheaper alternatives. Make sure to also check our [Midnight Profession Guide](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/professions/overview) for all profession details.

### Outlaw Rogue Gems

For maximum damage, you will want to use [![Powerful Eversong Diamond](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_jewelcrafting_epic_gem_cut_orange.gif)Powerful Eversong Diamond![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=240967/powerful-eversong-diamond) as your Thalassian Diamond, and a combination of at least 1 Peridot, 1 Lapis, 1 Garnet, and 1 Amethyst, then [![Versatile Emerald](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_jewelcrafting_cut-standart-gem-hybrid_color1_1.gif)Versatile Emerald![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier3.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=213485/versatile-emerald) in all other sockets.

- **Peridot**: [![Flawless Deadly Peridot](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_jewelcrafting_rare_gem_cut_fire_green.gif)Flawless Deadly Peridot![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=240890/flawless-deadly-peridot)

- **Onyx**: [![Flawless Deadly Amethyst](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_jewelcrafting_rare_gem_cut_fire_purple.gif)Flawless Deadly Amethyst![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=240898/flawless-deadly-amethyst)

- **Garnet**: [![Flawless Quick Garnet](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_jewelcrafting_rare_gem_cut_nature_red.gif)Flawless Quick Garnet![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=240906/flawless-quick-garnet)

- **Lapis**: [![Flawless Quick Lapis](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_jewelcrafting_rare_gem_cut_nature_blue.gif)Flawless Quick Lapis![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=240916/flawless-quick-lapis)


As always, sim yourself as Haste can be a fickle thing to optimize perfectly.

### Outlaw Rogue Weapon Enchant

As mentioned above, Haste can be a tricky thing to optimize perfectly for this spec which means that [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/trade_engineering.gif)Temp Torment Frost Visual](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=243970/temp-torment-frost-visual) or [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/trade_engineering.gif)Temp Torment Shadow Visual](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=243972/temp-torment-shadow-visual) could swap value after even just a few gear upgrades. Always double check by simming with Raidbots to figure out optimal damage.

## ~~~~ Best Outlaw Rogue Consumables in Midnight Season 1

There are many consumables that players can use in combat in The War Within. Here are the best flasks, potions, and weapon buffs that Outlaw Rogue can use in PvE content.

While Versatility is generally recommended as the safest option for gearing characters and for the added benefit of smoothing out gameplay feel, you should ideally be simming your character using [raidbots](https://www.raidbots.com/simbot) to determine the best configuration for you.

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| **Type** | **Best** |
| Flask | [![Flask of the Shattered Sun](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_alchemy_flask_sindoreipotion_red--.gif)Flask of the Shattered Sun![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241326/flask-of-the-shattered-sun) or [![Flask of the Blood Knights](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_alchemy_flask_sindoreipotion_white-.gif)Flask of the Blood Knights![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241324/flask-of-the-blood-knights) |
| Combat Potion | [![Light's Potential](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_alchemy_lightpotion_yellow.gif)Light's Potential![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier1.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241309/lights-potential) |
| Health Potion | [![Silvermoon Health Potion](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_alchemy_lightpotion_orange.gif)Silvermoon Health Potion![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier1.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241305/silvermoon-health-potion) |
| Weapon Buff | [![Thalassian Phoenix Oil](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_enchanting_manaoil_red.gif)Thalassian Phoenix Oil![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=243734/thalassian-phoenix-oil) |
| Augment Rune | [![Void-Touched Augment Rune](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_10_enchanting_crystal_color2.gif)Void-Touched Augment Rune](https://www.wowhead.com/item=259085/void-touched-augment-rune) |
| Food | [![Harandar Celebration](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_misc_1h_soup_b_01_misc_1h_soup_b_01.gif)Harandar Celebration](https://www.wowhead.com/item=255846/harandar-celebration) |

### Outlaw Rogue Flask

The best Flask for Outlaw Rogue is [![Flask of the Shattered Sun](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_alchemy_flask_sindoreipotion_red--.gif)Flask of the Shattered Sun![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241326/flask-of-the-shattered-sun) or [![Flask of the Blood Knights](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_alchemy_flask_sindoreipotion_white-.gif)Flask of the Blood Knights![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241324/flask-of-the-blood-knights) and will depend entirely on if you need the haste from [![Flask of the Blood Knights](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_alchemy_flask_sindoreipotion_white-.gif)Flask of the Blood Knights![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241324/flask-of-the-blood-knights) to reach the important 25% breakpoint. If you don't need it then go for [![Flask of the Shattered Sun](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_alchemy_flask_sindoreipotion_red--.gif)Flask of the Shattered Sun![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241326/flask-of-the-shattered-sun).

### Outlaw Rogue Combat Potions

The best combat potion for Outlaw Rogue is [![Light's Potential](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_alchemy_lightpotion_yellow.gif)Light's Potential![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier1.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241309/lights-potential).

### Outlaw Rogue Health Potions

The best healing potion for Outlaw Rogue is [![Silvermoon Health Potion](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_alchemy_lightpotion_orange.gif)Silvermoon Health Potion![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier1.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241305/silvermoon-health-potion).

### Outlaw Rogue Weapon Buff

The best weapon buff for Outlaw Rogue is [![Thalassian Phoenix Oil](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_enchanting_manaoil_red.gif)Thalassian Phoenix Oil![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=243734/thalassian-phoenix-oil).

### Outlaw Rogue Augment Rune

For midnight, the new Augment Rune is [![Void-Touched Augment Rune](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_10_enchanting_crystal_color2.gif)Void-Touched Augment Rune](https://www.wowhead.com/item=259085/void-touched-augment-rune).

### Outlaw Rogue Food

Outlaw Rogue is most likely using feast buffs in TWW due to how valuable Agility is for the class. As always, sim your character to see which food is best for your secondary stat configuration.

- Feast: [![Harandar Celebration](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_misc_1h_soup_b_01_misc_1h_soup_b_01.gif)Harandar Celebration](https://www.wowhead.com/item=255846/harandar-celebration)

- Personal Food: [![Champion's Bento](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_misc_food_vendor_poundedricecake_1.gif)Champion's Bento](https://www.wowhead.com/item=242274/champions-bento), [![Sun-Seared Lumifin](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_misc_food_cooked_wildfowlroast.gif)Sun-Seared Lumifin](https://www.wowhead.com/item=242283/sun-seared-lumifin), or [![Crimson Calamari](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_misc_food_cooked_valleystirfry.gif)Crimson Calamari](https://www.wowhead.com/item=242277/crimson-calamari)

[![Enchant Weapon - Arcane Mastery](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_enchanting_enchantedvellum_purple.gif)Enchant Weapon - Arcane Mastery![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=244031/enchant-weapon-arcane-mastery) is better while you are still gearing up and lack Mastery from your Gear and other sources, but the lack of consistency on the proc works against us trying to stay as close to capped as possible for as long as possible. Below, we've listed the best flasks, potions, and weapon buffs that Elemental Shamans can use in PvE content. While Mastery is generally recommended as the safest option for gearing characters and for the added benefit of smoothing out gameplay feel, you should ideally be simming your character using [raidbots](https://www.raidbots.com/simbot) to determine the best configuration for you.

### Elemental Shaman Flask

The best Flask for Elemental Shamans is [![Flask of the Magisters](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_alchemy_flask_sindoreipotion_black.gif)Flask of the Magisters![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241322/flask-of-the-magisters). Mastery is our best stat so getting more of it is good.

### Elemental Shaman Combat Potions

Combat Potions put us in a similar situation as choosing our flask did. [![Potion of Recklessness](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_alchemy_voidpotion_red.gif)Potion of Recklessness![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241288/potion-of-recklessness) gives us a strong Mastery boost, which is good while still gearing up, but becomes obsolete when we get to our Mastery goals. When you get to 70% Mastery and over, change to [![Light's Potential](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_alchemy_lightpotion_yellow.gif)Light's Potential![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241308/lights-potential) giving a plain main stat boost, which is especially good at the start of the expansion.

### Elemental Shaman Health Potions

The best healing potion for Elemental Shamans is [![Silvermoon Health Potion](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_alchemy_lightpotion_orange.gif)Silvermoon Health Potion![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241304/silvermoon-health-potion).

### Elemental Shaman Weapon Buff

If you are talented into [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_flametounge.gif)Flametongue Weapon](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=318038/flametongue-weapon), do not use any weapon oils, but instead use [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_flametounge.gif)Flametongue Weapon](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=318038/flametongue-weapon) to imbue your weapon. Otherwise you use [![Thalassian Phoenix Oil](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_enchanting_manaoil_red.gif)Thalassian Phoenix Oil![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier1.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=243733/thalassian-phoenix-oil).

### Elemental Shaman Augment Rune

The Augment rune in Midnight is [![Void-Touched Augment Rune](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_10_enchanting_crystal_color2.gif)Void-Touched Augment Rune](https://www.wowhead.com/item=259085/void-touched-augment-rune) giving a minor main stat bonus which is lost on death.

### Elemental Shaman Food

In Midnight, Elemental Shamans will use [![Harandar Celebration](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_misc_1h_soup_b_01_misc_1h_soup_b_01.gif)Harandar Celebration](https://www.wowhead.com/item=255846/harandar-celebration) as their feast of choice, giving some main stat which is especially good at the start of the expansion.

### Enhancement Shaman Gems

It's generally best to sim your character to find the absolute best gems to put in gear. Everyone has access to a minimum of 3, as each piece of jewelry always comes with one socket each. In Midnight, Agility is valued so highly that you should _always_ be using an Eversong Diamond in your first socket. After that, you should mix gems based on gear needs:

- **Eversong Diamond**: [![Indecipherable Eversong Diamond](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_jewelcrafting_epic_gem_cut_green.gif)Indecipherable Eversong Diamond![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=240983/indecipherable-eversong-diamond).

- **Other Gems**: [![Flawless Quick Amethyst](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_jewelcrafting_rare_gem_cut_nature_purple.gif)Flawless Quick Amethyst![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=240900/flawless-quick-amethyst) and [![Flawless Masterful Peridot](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_jewelcrafting_rare_gem_cut_void_green.gif)Flawless Masterful Peridot![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=240892/flawless-masterful-peridot)


### Enhancement Shaman Weapon Enchant

In Midnight, due to the significantly higher value of Agility, [![Enchant Weapon - Acuity of the Ren'dorei](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_enchanting_enchantedvellum_purple.gif)Enchant Weapon - Acuity of the Ren'dorei![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=244029/enchant-weapon-acuity-of-the-rendorei) is the best choice in the majority of situations. At extremely high gear levels, secondary boosting enchants begin to compete, but aren't best to use early in the season.

### Enhancement Shaman Flask

In Midnight, the best general flask to use is [![Flask of the Magisters](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_alchemy_flask_sindoreipotion_black.gif)Flask of the Magisters![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241322/flask-of-the-magisters). That said, Flasks are also a great way to re-balance your stats if you're lacking one in your current gearset (especially if switching Hero Trees). Due to that, both [![Flask of the Blood Knights](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_alchemy_flask_sindoreipotion_white-.gif)Flask of the Blood Knights![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241324/flask-of-the-blood-knights) and [![Flask of the Shattered Sun](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_alchemy_flask_sindoreipotion_red--.gif)Flask of the Shattered Sun![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241326/flask-of-the-shattered-sun) are also useful. ### Enhancement Shaman Combat Potions

There's a few potions available in Midnight, but currently in Season 1 the strongest is [![Light's Potential](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_alchemy_lightpotion_yellow.gif)Light's Potential![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241308/lights-potential). These can also be obtained from an [![Voidlight Potion Cauldron](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_misc_cauldron_shadow.gif)Voidlight Potion Cauldron![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241284/voidlight-potion-cauldron) if your group is using one.

### Enhancement Shaman Health Potions

The best healing potion for Enhancement Shaman is [![Silvermoon Health Potion](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_alchemy_lightpotion_orange.gif)Silvermoon Health Potion![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241304/silvermoon-health-potion).

### Enhancement Shaman Weapon Buff

Unfortunately, due to the Weapon Imbues ( [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_flametounge.gif)Flametongue Weapon](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=318038/flametongue-weapon) and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shaman_unleashweapon_wind.gif)Windfury Weapon](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=33757/windfury-weapon)) that Enhancement uses, it **CANNOT** use weapon enhancements such as oils or whetstones _at the same time_. Due to the way that [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_mace_2h_draenorraid_d_03.gif)Elemental Weapons](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=384355/elemental-weapons) works, opting out of these is **not** an option, so we **do not** use runes.

### Enhancement Shaman Augment Rune

The Augment Rune available in Midnight is [![Void-Touched Augment Rune](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_10_enchanting_crystal_color2.gif)Void-Touched Augment Rune](https://www.wowhead.com/item=259085/void-touched-augment-rune). These can be acquired from the weekly housing quest, but bear in mind they're lost on death and are very expensive!

[By Kalamazi](https://www.wowhead.com/author/Kalamazi)

There are a couple of different potions that have different useful scenarios for Affliction Warlocks:

For their weapons, Affliction Warlocks will always use [![Thalassian Phoenix Oil](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_enchanting_manaoil_red.gif)Thalassian Phoenix Oil![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=243734/thalassian-phoenix-oil).

Affliction Warlocks are most likely using a feast buff over personal stat food due to stat allocation, but personal food is more than fine to use if feasts are not available.

Both Hero Talents provide good throughput for both single and multi-target damage. You will often find yourself choosing your Hero Talent based on what defensive capability or utility is required. If you need more overall movement and increased defensives, you will go the route of Diabolist for things like [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_demoniccircleteleport.gif)Soul-Etched Circles](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=428911/soul-etched-circles) and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_fabric_felcloth_ebon.gif)Infernal Vitality](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=429115/infernal-vitality). The AoE you bring with Diabolist is also much more passive and less reliant on [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warlock_spelldrain.gif)Demonic Core](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=267102/demonic-core) procs than Soul Harvester. If you are interested in the 0.1%, Diabolist is the most optimal choice under extreme circumstances, but playing Soul Harvester will not be game-breaking. [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/ability_marksmanship.jpg)Talent Builds](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warlock/demonology/talent-builds-pve-dps) ## ~~~~ Playing a Demonology Warlock in Midnight Season 1 Demonology Warlock's rotation is more about optimizing your damage during cooldown windows; this is fairly obvious to follow due to the simplified core rotation. Try to adhere to two basic rules for Demonology: | | | | --- | --- | | | | | | --- | --- | | ~~~~ | **Do not overcap on [![Soul Shards](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_misc_gem_amethyst_02.gif)Soul Shards](https://www.wowhead.com/resource/soul-shards-7):** [![Soul Shards](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_misc_gem_amethyst_02.gif)Soul Shards](https://www.wowhead.com/resource/soul-shards-7) are your resource and are limited to a maximum of 5. Overcapping them is a DPS loss and they should not be pooled unless heading into a damage window. | * * * | | | | --- | --- | | ~~~~ | **Demon stacking:** [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_summondemonictyrant.gif)Summon Demonic Tyrant](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=265187/summon-demonic-tyrant) is our main demon buffing ability. By ensuring that you're always setting up the maximum number of Wild Imps, your Vilefiend, and Dreadstalkers when possible, you will both give yourself the most damage possible through your cooldowns, and ensure maximum uptime of all the buffs and debuffs you get through your demons. | | [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/spell_mekkatorque_bot_bluegear.jpg)Rotation](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warlock/demonology/rotation-cooldowns-pve-dps) [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/inv_112_achievement_raid_manaforgeomega.jpg)Raid Tips](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warlock/demonology/manaforge-omega-raid-tips) [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/inv_relics_hourglass.jpg)Mythic+](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warlock/demonology/mythic-plus-dungeon-tips) ## ~~~~ Gearing a Demonology Warlock in Midnight Season 1 As a general guideline, follow the stat priority of: **Haste = Critical Strike > Mastery > Versatility**. Don't neglect the value of **Intellect**, as a substantial increase in item level is typically going to be worth it compared to optimized stats. It is always recommended that you use [Raidbots](https://www.raidbots.com/simbot/stats) to sim your own character, since every character is different. [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/inv_chest_chain_03.jpg)Best-in-Slot Gear](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warlock/demonology/bis-gear) ## ~~~~ What Professions are Best for Demonology Warlock? Compared to previous expansions, professions in Midnight provide minimal benefits towards the performance of your spec. This means that Demonology Warlock players can choose any profession according to personal preference. You might consider [Tailoring](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/midnight/professions/tailoring-overview-trainer-locations-recipes-tools) to craft your own armor, as many profession items can be very close to your [Best in Slot gear](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warlock/demonology/bis-gear). On the other hand, you may opt for [Alchemy](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/midnight/professions/alchemy-overview-trainer-locations-recipes-tools) to craft consumables or [Enchanting](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/midnight/professions/enchanting-overview-trainer-locations-recipes-tools) to enchant gear without relying on the Auction House. [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/inv_inscription_80_warscroll_intellect.jpg)Stats](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warlock/demonology/stat-priority-pve-dps) [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/ui_concentration.jpg)Professions in Midnight](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/professions/overview) ## ~~~~ What Race is Best for Demonology Warlock? ## ~~~~ Talent Build for Demonology Warlock Beginners

For beginners it is more recommended to play the most basic version of Demonology, where you can get a handle on the core rotation in both single target and AOE before adding in another cooldown or target swapping to play around certain talents. Either Hero Talent is playable for beginners as the complexity of the spec does not change.

## ~~~~ Rotation Priority for Demonology Warlock Beginners

This is a simple example of the spell priorities that make up the Demonology Warlock rotation. More information about the rotation, as well as an explanation of important abilities and advanced tips can be found in the [Demonology Warlock Rotation Guide](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warlock/demonology/rotation-cooldowns-pve-dps).

| ~~~~ | **Builders:** Build [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_misc_gem_amethyst_02.gif)Soul Shards](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=246985/soul-shards) with either [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_shadowbolt.gif)Shadow Bolt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=686/shadow-bolt) or with [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv__demonbolt.gif)Demonbolt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=264178/demonbolt) when you have [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warlock_spelldrain.gif)Demonic Core](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=267102/demonic-core). |

* * *

|     |     |

[![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_warlock_calldreadstalkers.gif)Call Dreadstalkers](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=104316/call-dreadstalkers) is also a spender if you are leveling and don't have access to the talent [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_felstalker_pet.gif)Demonic Calling](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1276947/demonic-calling). |

* * *

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| ~~~~ | **Cooldowns:** Pressing your [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_summondemonictyrant.gif)Summon Demonic Tyrant](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=265187/summon-demonic-tyrant) as often as possible when you have your [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_warlock_calldreadstalkers.gif)Call Dreadstalkers](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=104316/call-dreadstalkers) out. | |

### Single Button Rotation Assistant

Assisted Highlight and Single-Button Assistant are two new tools designed to assist players with general combat rotation and how their class spells and abilities influence one another. For Demonology Warlock, these tools are a **heavily simplified rotation**, which presents many issues and will come with a hefty tax of a significant DPS loss. While you can use it for general farming, transmog runs, older content, or if you're really into that new show you're watching, it should not be used during any kind of actual group play activities or be used as a means to help you really learn how to play Demonology.

The biggest drawback for Demonology is that it does use some of our cooldowns, but simply on cooldown and without teaching you how to set up your [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_summondemonictyrant.gif)Summon Demonic Tyrant](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=265187/summon-demonic-tyrant) or use [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_implosion.gif)Implosion](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=196277/implosion) at all if you're in an AoE setting.

Both tools are much more of an "accessibility" tool than any kind of rotation assist tool for Demonology, as you don't learn much (or anything) about core Demonology mechanics in either single target or AoE situations outside of the extreme basic buttons to use.

## ~~~~ Best Stats for Demonology Warlock Beginners

Demonology Warlock generally likes all stats fairly equally with some preference towards Haste and Critical Strike. Stats are generally close enough that you should consider item level as the "best stat" for you.

For more details, check our [Demonology Warlock Stats guide](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warlock/demonology/stat-priority-pve-dps).

## ~~~~ Baseline Demonology Warlock Spells

### Offensive Abilities

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_shadowbolt.gif)Shadow Bolt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=686/shadow-bolt) **(SB)** \- Single target filler spell that generates one Soul Shard.


### Defensive Cooldowns

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_demonictactics.gif)Unending Resolve](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=104773/unending-resolve) **(UR)** \- Shield wall effect, granting you damage reduction and immunity to spell cast interrupts.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_lifedrain02.gif)Drain Life](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=234153/drain-life) \- Drains life from your target and restores it to you.


### Utility Abilities

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_possession.gif)Fear](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=5782/fear) \- Fears a target in a random direction.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_curseofmannoroth.gif)Curse of Weakness](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=702/curse-of-weakness) \- Debuff applied to an enemy mob, increasing the time between their attacks.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warlock_-healthstone.gif)Create Healthstone](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=6201/create-healthstone) \- Usable item that restores 25% of your life on use.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_soulgem.gif)Soulstone](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=20707/soulstone) **(SS)** \- Allows the target to resurrect after dying in combat. Usable before or during combat.


### Passive Abilities

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_misc_gem_amethyst_02.gif)Soul Shards](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=246985/soul-shards) \- Secondary power, passively regenerates up to three Soul Shards when out of combat.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warlock_spelldrain.gif)Demonic Core](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=267102/demonic-core) \- When Wild Imps expire or [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_warlock_calldreadstalkers.gif)Call Dreadstalkers](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=104316/call-dreadstalkers) expire you have a chance to gain a [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warlock_spelldrain.gif)Demonic Core](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=267102/demonic-core) which reduces the cast time of [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv__demonbolt.gif)Demonbolt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=264178/demonbolt) by 100%.


## Demonology Warlock Hero Talents

### Diabolist Demonology Warlock Talents

**Key Talent**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_bossfelorcs_necromancer_purple.gif)Diabolic Ritual](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=428514/diabolic-ritual) \- After spending [![Soul Shards](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_misc_gem_amethyst_02.gif)Soul Shards](https://www.wowhead.com/resource/soul-shards-7) on an ability that deals damage, gain [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_bossfelorcs_necromancer_purple.gif)Diabolic Ritual](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=428514/diabolic-ritual). When [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_bossfelorcs_necromancer_purple.gif)Diabolic Ritual](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=428514/diabolic-ritual) expires you gain the ability to summon one of three empowered demons, [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_creature_felfrenzy.gif)Demonic Art: Overlord](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=428524/demonic-art-overlord), [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/achievement_boss_argus_shivan.gif)Demonic Art: Mother of Chaos](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=432794/demonic-art-mother-of-chaos) and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_bossmannoroth_empoweredmannorothsgaze.gif)Demonic Art: Pit Lord](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=432795/demonic-art-pit-lord) after casting [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_handofguldan.gif)Hand of Gul'dan](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=105174/hand-of-guldan). The empowered demons always come out in the same order as listed just previously.


**Capstone Talent**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_bossmannoroth_empoweredmannorothsgaze.gif)Ruination](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=428522/ruination) \- After summoning [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_bossmannoroth_empoweredmannorothsgaze.gif)Demonic Art: Pit Lord](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=432795/demonic-art-pit-lord), your [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_handofguldan.gif)Hand of Gul'dan](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=105174/hand-of-guldan) is transformed into [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_felflamestrike.gif)Ruination](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=434635/ruination); dealing additional damage and summoning 3 Wild Imps.


**Choice Nodes**

- Choice Node 1:

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_demoniccircleteleport.gif)Soul-Etched Circles](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=428911/soul-etched-circles) \- Whenever you cast [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_demoniccirclesummon.gif)Demonic Circle](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=268358/demonic-circle), gain the effect of [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_warlock_soulburn.gif)Soulburn](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=385899/soulburn) without using either the cooldown or [![Soul Shards](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_misc_gem_amethyst_02.gif)Soul Shards](https://www.wowhead.com/resource/soul-shards-7).

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_physical_taunt.gif)Annihilan's Bellow](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=429072/annihilans-bellow) \- Reduced cooldown and increased range for [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_howlofterror.gif)Howl of Terror](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=5484/howl-of-terror).


- Choice Node 2:

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/creatureportrait_fomorhand.gif)Cruelty of Kerxan](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=429902/cruelty-of-kerxan) \- Casting [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_summondemonictyrant.gif)Summon Demonic Tyrant](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=265187/summon-demonic-tyrant) also grants [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_bossfelorcs_necromancer_purple.gif)Diabolic Ritual](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=428514/diabolic-ritual) and reduces the duration of the ritual by 3 seconds.

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_misc_supersoulash.gif)Infernal Machine](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=429917/infernal-machine) \- Spending [![Soul Shards](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_misc_gem_amethyst_02.gif)Soul Shards](https://www.wowhead.com/resource/soul-shards-7) while [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_summondemonictyrant.gif)Summon Demonic Tyrant](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=265187/summon-demonic-tyrant) is active reduces the duration of your next [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_bossfelorcs_necromancer_purple.gif)Diabolic Ritual](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=428514/diabolic-ritual).


- Choice Node 3:

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_fabric_felcloth_ebon.gif)Infernal Vitality](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=429115/infernal-vitality) \- In addition the the damage reduction, [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_demonictactics.gif)Unending Resolve](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=104773/unending-resolve) heals for 30% of your maximum health over time.

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_felfireward.gif)Infernal Bulwark](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=429130/infernal-bulwark) \- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_demonictactics.gif)Unending Resolve](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=104773/unending-resolve) grants an additional shielding effect to [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warlock_siphonlife.gif)Soul Leech](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=108370/soul-leech).


**Passives**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_creature_felfrenzy.gif)Cloven Souls](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=428517/cloven-souls) \- Enemies damaged by [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_creature_felfrenzy.gif)Demonic Art: Overlord](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=428524/demonic-art-overlord) also take an additional 5% damage from you and all your pets.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_bossfellord_felspike.gif)Touch of Rancora](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=429893/touch-of-rancora) \- When [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_creature_felfrenzy.gif)Demonic Art: Overlord](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=428524/demonic-art-overlord), [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/achievement_boss_argus_shivan.gif)Demonic Art: Mother of Chaos](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=432794/demonic-art-mother-of-chaos) or [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_bossmannoroth_empoweredmannorothsgaze.gif)Demonic Art: Pit Lord](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=432795/demonic-art-pit-lord) activate, your next [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_handofguldan.gif)Hand of Gul'dan](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=105174/hand-of-guldan) deals increased damage and has a faster cast time.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_destructivesoul.gif)Swift Artifice](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=452902/swift-artifice) \- Quality of life cast time reduction on [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_soulgem.gif)Soulstone](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=20707/soulstone) and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warlock_-healthstone.gif)Create Healthstone](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=6201/create-healthstone).

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_soullink.gif)Soul Link](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=108415/soul-link) \- Enables you to take extra damage reduction, which is transferred to your pet.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/achievement_dungeon_outland_dungeonmaster.gif)Frequent Traveler](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1265801/frequent-traveler) \- Reduces cast time of Demonic Gateway and allows you to use it twice before going on cooldown.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_sword_1h_felfireraid_d_01.gif)Fel Synergy](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=389367/fel-synergy) \- Provides you with additional healing from [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warlock_siphonlife.gif)Soul Leech](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=108370/soul-leech).

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_shadowfury.gif)Oppressive Darkness](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1270255/oppressive-darkness) \- Reduces the cooldown of Shadowfury or Howl of Terror, increases radius or fears additional targets.


#### Row 10 Talents

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warlock_-bloodstone.gif)Pact of Gluttony](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=386689/pact-of-gluttony) \- When you conjure a [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warlock_-healthstone.gif)Create Healthstone](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=6201/create-healthstone) for yourself it transforms into a [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warlock_-bloodstone.gif)Demonic Healthstone](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=452930/demonic-healthstone) that can be used multiple times during an encounter which also gives you a healing over time effect when used.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_warlock_soulburn.gif)Soulburn](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=385899/soulburn) **(SB)** \- For the cost of a Soul Shard, empowers various utility spells to have an additional effect.

- Choice Node:


  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warlock_curse_weakness_amplified.gif)Blight of Weakness](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1271748/blight-of-weakness) \- Summon a mist that surrounds targets within a 10 yard range, reducing their time between attacks and critical strike chance.

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_curseoftongues_amplified.gif)Blight of Tongues](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1271802/blight-of-tongues) \- Summon a mist that surrounds targets within a 10 yard range, reducing their cast speed.

### Demonology Specialization Talents

#### Apex Talents

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv12_apextalent_warlock_dominionofargus.gif)Dominion of Argus](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1276163/dominion-of-argus) \- When you summon your Demonic Tyrant, open a portal to Argus causing additional demons to be summoned when casting Hand of Gul'dan.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv12_apextalent_warlock_dominionofargus.gif)Dominion of Argus](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1276190/dominion-of-argus) \- Increase the damage of your Hand of Gul'dan and increase the duration of your portal opened to Argus.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv12_apextalent_warlock_dominionofargus.gif)Dominion of Argus](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1276222/dominion-of-argus) \- While your portal to Argus is open, Hand of Gul'dan will refund 1 Soul Shard.


#### Row 1 Talents

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_handofguldan.gif)Hand of Gul'dan](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=105174/hand-of-guldan) **(HoG)** \- Does AoE in an 8 yard radius and summons Wild Imps equal to the number of Soul Shards you spend on it.


#### Row 2 Talents

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_demonbolt.gif)Demoniac](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=426115/demoniac) \- Grants the ability to cast a Soul Shard generating ability, single target. Additionally allows you to gain stacks of [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warlock_spelldrain.gif)Demonic Core](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=267102/demonic-core), which can be stored up to three times to make [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv__demonbolt.gif)Demonbolt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=264178/demonbolt) instant cast.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_warlock_calldreadstalkers.gif)Call Dreadstalkers](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=104316/call-dreadstalkers) **(Dogs)** \- Summons two [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_warlock_calldreadstalkers.gif)Call Dreadstalkers](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=104316/call-dreadstalkers) to attack a single target.


#### Row 3 Talents

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warlock_curse_shadow.gif)Dominant Hand](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1276433/dominant-hand) \- Increase the damage of your Hand of Gul'dan to your main target.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_kaztik_dominatemind.gif)Fel Intellect](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1250372/fel-intellect) \- Baseline Intellect increase.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_10_inscription_illusoryspellscrolls_color4.gif)Practiced Rituals](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1250375/practiced-rituals) \- Baseline Mastery increase.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_summonvoidwalker.gif)Dreadlash](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=264078/dreadlash) **(DL)** \- Enables your [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_warlock_calldreadstalkers.gif)Call Dreadstalkers](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=104316/call-dreadstalkers) to have an AoE effect when summoned and have their [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_warlock_calldreadstalkers.gif)Dreadbite](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=271971/dreadbite) deal additional damage.


#### Row 4 Talents

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_warlock_summonimpoutland.gif)Imp-erator](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=416230/imp-erator) \- Increases the critical strike chance of your Wild Imps.

- Choice Node:


  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_implosion.gif)Implosion](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=196277/implosion) \- Explode up to 6 of your Wild Imps for AoE damage.

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_backdraft.gif)Power Siphon](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=264130/power-siphon) **(PS)** \- Sacrifice two Wild Imps for two charges of [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warlock_spelldrain.gif)Demonic Core](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=267102/demonic-core) and makes the next two casts of [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv__demonbolt.gif)Demonbolt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=264178/demonbolt) deal additional damage.


- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_summonfelguard.gif)Summon Felguard](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=30146/summon-felguard) \- Enables you to summon your Felguard as a primary pet.


#### Row 5 Talents

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_argus_withering_fire.gif)Infernal Rapidity](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1263941/infernal-rapidity) \- Chance for your Wild Imps to duplicate their cast with increased effect.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_rune.gif)Rune of Shadows](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=453744/rune-of-shadows) \- Increases the damage and reduces the cast time of [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_shadowbolt.gif)Shadow Bolt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=686/shadow-bolt).

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warlock_pvp_callfelhunter.gif)Carnivorous Stalkers](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=386194/carnivorous-stalkers) \- Your [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_warlock_calldreadstalkers.gif)Call Dreadstalkers](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=104316/call-dreadstalkers) have an additional chance to recast their signature ability, [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_warlock_calldreadstalkers.gif)Dreadbite](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=271971/dreadbite).

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_misc_desecrated_plategloves.gif)Fel Armaments](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1263935/fel-armaments) \- Reduce the cooldown of your Felguard's Felstorm and reduces its damage taken.


#### Row 6 Talents

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_empoweredimp.gif)Imp Gang Boss](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1250768/imp-gang-boss) \- Empower one of your Wild Imps each time they are summoned by Hand of Gul'dan, increasing its damage.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_demonhunter_bladedance.gif)Demonic Brutality](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=453908/demonic-brutality) \- All your demons deal additional damage when they critically hit.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_eradication.gif)Inner Demons](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=267216/inner-demons) \- Passively summon a Wild Imp every 12s.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_summondemonictyrant.gif)Summon Demonic Tyrant](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=265187/summon-demonic-tyrant) **(Tyrant)** \- Summons a Demonic Tyrant that has increased damage for each Wild Imp and Dreadstalker active.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_creature_poison_01.gif)Blighted Maw](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1276956/blighted-maw) \- Gives your Dreadstalkers additional damage when they Dreadbite.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_ancientgrimoire.gif)Improved Demonic Tactics](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=453800/improved-demonic-tactics) \- Increases your primary Felguard's critical strike chance, relative to your own.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_axe_2h_demonweapon_c_01.gif)Empowered Felstorm](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1279575/empowered-felstorm) \- Improves the damage of your Felguard's Felstorm and increases its duration.


#### Row 7 Talents

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_impphaseshift.gif)Spiteful Reconstitution](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=428394/spiteful-reconstitution) \- Damage buff to [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_implosion.gif)Implosion](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=196277/implosion) and gives you a chance to summon a Wild Imp when consuming [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warlock_spelldrain.gif)Demonic Core](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=267102/demonic-core).

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_warlock_demonwrath.gif)Tyrant's Oblation](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1276746/tyrants-oblation) \- While Demonic Tyrant is active, increase your Haste.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_plate_helmet_eredarargus_d_01.gif)Antoran Armaments](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1250921/antoran-armaments) \- Empowers your Demonic Tyrant further, making it melee and giving it a powerful cleave.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shaman_firenova.gif)Flametouched](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=453699/flametouched) \- Increased attack speed and critical strike chance of your [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_warlock_calldreadstalkers.gif)Call Dreadstalkers](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=104316/call-dreadstalkers).


#### Row 8 Talents

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_ritualofsacrifice.gif)Demonic Sacrifice](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=186185/demonic-sacrifice) \- Hand of Gul'dan has a chance to generate a Demonic Core.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_creature_disease_05.gif)Sacrificed Souls](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=267214/sacrificed-souls) \- For every demon summoned, your Shadow Bolt and Demonbolt have increased damage.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_demonicpower.gif)Reign of Tyranny](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1276748/reign-of-tyranny) \- Increases the duration of Demonic Tyrant and extends the duration of your Dreadstalkers when summoned.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_ritualofsacrifice.gif)Demonic Sacrifice](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=186185/demonic-sacrifice) \- Passive mastery increase and reduces the cast time of your Felguard and Demonic Tyrant.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_ritualofsacrifice.gif)Demonic Sacrifice](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=186185/demonic-sacrifice) \- Reduce the cast time of your Call Dreadstalkers and make them cost one less Soul Shard.


#### Row 9 Talents

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_auraofdarkness.gif)Doom](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=460551/doom) \- After consuming a [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warlock_spelldrain.gif)Demonic Core](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=267102/demonic-core), place a DoT on the target dealing AoE damage after 20s, the duration of [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_auraofdarkness.gif)Doom](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=460551/doom) is reduced by 1 second per Soul Shard spent on [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_handofguldan.gif)Hand of Gul'dan](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=105174/hand-of-guldan).

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_helm_cloth_pvpwarlock_o_01.gif)Hellbent Commander](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1250897/hellbent-commander) \- For every demon currently being controlled, increase the damage done by all other demons.

- Choice Node:


  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_imp3_purple.gif)Grimoire: Imp Lord](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1276452/grimoire-imp-lord) \- Summon an Imp Lord for a limited time which dispels you when summoned. While on cooldown, gain the ability to dispel magic.

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_ritualofsacrifice.gif)Demonic Sacrifice](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=186185/demonic-sacrifice) \- Summon a Fel Ravager which with interrupt the target it is cast on and deal damage for a limited time. While on cooldown, gain the ability to interrupt a cast on a 20 second cooldown.


- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_argusfelstalkermount.gif)Summon Vilefiend](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1251778/summon-vilefiend) \- Call Dreadstalkers also summons a Vilefiend.


#### Row 10 Talents

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warlock_summon_doomguard.gif)Summon Doomguard](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1276672/summon-doomguard) \- Summon a Doomguard for a short period of time which casts AoE hitting up to 5 enemies at a time. Each time you consume a Demonic Core, reduce the cooldown of this ability.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_argusfelstalkermount.gif)Summon Vilefiend](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1251778/summon-vilefiend) \- Power Siphon and Implosion summon an Imp Gang Boss for every two Wild Imps they sacrifice. Wild Imps summoned can gain an additional effect which deals increased damage and cleaves to 4 targets.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_argusfelstalkermount.gif)Summon Vilefiend](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1251778/summon-vilefiend) \- Increase the duration of your Summon Vilefiend and Imp Lord or Fel Ravager.

- Choice Node:


  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_felhound3_shadow_mount.gif)Mark of Shatug](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=455449/mark-of-shatug) **(Purple Dog)** \- An empowered version of [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_argusfelstalkermount.gif)Summon Vilefiend](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=264119/summon-vilefiend) which deals increased damage in single target.

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_felhound3_shadow_fire.gif)Mark of F'harg](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=455450/mark-of-fharg) **(Red Dog)** \- An empowered version of [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_argusfelstalkermount.gif)Summon Vilefiend](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=264119/summon-vilefiend) which deals increased damage in AoE.

* * *

to diminishing returns. This means that adding more of the same stat beyond certain thresholds results in reduced benefits. These thresholds are fixed and reduce the amount gained from more of that stat rating by 10% per breakpoint. Each stat has a different rating threshold where the reduction begins: - **Critical Strike** \- Above 1380 rating - **Haste** \- Above 1320 rating - **Mastery** \- Above 1380 rating - **Versatility** \- Above 1620 rating **Example** Let's assume you gain 1% Haste for 10 Haste Rating. When above the diminishing return breakpoint, 10 Haste Rating would give you 0.9% Haste instead, resulting in a 10% reduction from what you gained previously. Note that this system **only counts stat rating**, meaning that percentage-based procs and effects like [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_nature_bloodlust.gif)Bloodlust](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=2825/bloodlust) aren't factored in and will always grant their full benefit. ## Pre-Combat Check

Before any combat happens, it is important for Demonology Warlock to make sure the following are done. This applies to raids, dungeons, delves, or even open-world content.

- **Get your food buff and oil applied!**

- **Summon your Felguard!**

- **Drop healthstones! -** Cast [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_shadesofdarkness.gif)Create Soulwell](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=29893/create-soulwell) for every party/raid member to get a [![Healthstone](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warlock_-healthstone.gif)Healthstone](https://www.wowhead.com/item=5512/healthstone)

- **Portals, portals everywhere! -** As needed, make sure your portals are down in an appropriate location. This includes both personal, [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_demoniccirclesummon.gif)Demonic Circle](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=268358/demonic-circle) and group, [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_warlock_demonicportal_green.gif)Demonic Gateway](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=111771/demonic-gateway) portals.

- **Double Check your Talents! -** Have another quick look to make sure you are in the correct talents for the boss, and you can't see any changes that might help.


## ~~~~ Demonology Warlock Major Cooldowns

Demonic Tyrant

Grimoires

Implosion

Doomguard

Felstorm

### Demonic Tyrant

[![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_summondemonictyrant.gif)Summon Demonic Tyrant](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=265187/summon-demonic-tyrant) is a staple cooldown and drives lot of our damage sequences. It extends the time of just your [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_warlock_calldreadstalkers.gif)Call Dreadstalkers](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=104316/call-dreadstalkers) when talented into [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_demonicpower.gif)Reign of Tyranny](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1276748/reign-of-tyranny); however, [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_summondemonictyrant.gif)Summon Demonic Tyrant](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=265187/summon-demonic-tyrant) gains an additional damage modifier for each demon summoned. Maximize this.

### Grimoires

[![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_imp3_purple.gif)Grimoire: Imp Lord](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1276452/grimoire-imp-lord) provides us with an on-demand self-dispel when summoned and deals moderate damage for a two-minute cooldown. While it's on cooldown, you also gain access to [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_elementaldevastation.gif)Singe Magic](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=132411/singe-magic), which can help dispel yourself and others in your party in a pinch. [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_summonfelhunter.gif)Grimoire: Fel Ravager](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1276467/grimoire-fel-ravager) is likely the more common option of the two simply because it will interrupt the target it's cast on, on demand, and when on cooldown, giving you access to another interrupt in the form of [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_mindrot.gif)Spell Lock](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=19647/spell-lock).

### Implosion

Our on-demand AoE is only available in the form of [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_implosion.gif)Implosion](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=196277/implosion). It is a 15s cooldown and consumes a maximum of 6 Wild Imps to deal AoE damage. Note that this will consume any number of Wild Imps **up to** 6, so there is a world where you can implode the non-maximum number of Wild Imps. It is recommended to always implode with the 6 Wild Imp maximum whenever possible.

### Doomguard

A powerful AoE cooldown that can be used whenever there are multiple targets. Be aware that it does have a target cap of 5 enemies, so if you cast it with more than 5 enemies around, it will not deal damage to more than those five targets at any given time.

### Felstorm

For more advanced players, turning **OFF** auto-cast from [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_bladestorm.gif)Felstorm](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=89751/felstorm) may be beneficial to your DPS in Single Target situations. This is primarily due to the energy it consumes that takes away from additional [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_axe_09.gif)Legion Strike](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=30213/legion-strike) casts and a few melee attacks from your Felguard. This tip is _EXTREMELY_ min-max and is not suitable for every player to use. If auto-cast is turned off and you are in a position to have it hit at least two targets but don't have your Felguard cast [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_bladestorm.gif)Felstorm](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=89751/felstorm), you will negate the other 'gains' you get by having it not auto-cast.

## ~~~~ Demonology Warlock Advanced Tips

Demonic Cores

### Demonic Cores

Since [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warlock_spelldrain.gif)Demonic Core](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=267102/demonic-core) are our most common proc which enables us to use a more efficient way of building Soul Shards, with this in mind managing this resource is extremely important. Demonic Cores only stack to a maximum of 4 and there are periods where you will want to bank charges of this resource for cooldown windows. For example, you would want a minimum of 2 charges for each time you approach a [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_summondemonictyrant.gif)Summon Demonic Tyrant](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=265187/summon-demonic-tyrant) cooldown as it will allow you to easily, and quickly, generate additional Soul Shards for more Wild Imps while your Demonic Tyrant is active, increasing its damage.

Another example of effective use of Demonic Cores is during AoE where you can spread [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_auraofdarkness.gif)Doom](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=460551/doom) to multiple targets for additional AoE since each application of Doom is its own damage source.

Ideally, you will want to hold 2 charges of [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warlock_spelldrain.gif)Demonic Core](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=267102/demonic-core) as often as possible. This is both a means of having quick resources available to you and allows you to not overcap your charges and waste procs.

There are many consumables that players can use in combat in Midnight Season 1. Here are the best phials, potions, and weapon buffs that Demonology Warlocks can use in PvE content.

While haste is generally a very safe option for gearing your character, you should ideally be simming your character using [raidbots](https://www.raidbots.com/simbot) to determine the best configuration for you.

### Best Consumables for Demonology Warlocks

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| **Type** | **Best** |

| Food | [![Royal Roast](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_cooking_100_roastduck.gif)Royal Roast](https://www.wowhead.com/item=242275/royal-roast) |

### Demonology Warlock Flask

The best Flask for Demonology Warlocks is [![Flask of the Shattered Sun](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_alchemy_flask_sindoreipotion_red--.gif)Flask of the Shattered Sun![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241326/flask-of-the-shattered-sun), though other stat flasks can still be used depending on your overall stat weighting.

### Demonology Warlock Combat Potions in Midnight Season 1

There are a couple of different potions that have different useful scenarios for Demonology Warlocks:

- **Raiding**: [![Light's Potential](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_alchemy_lightpotion_yellow.gif)Light's Potential![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241308/lights-potential)

- **Mythic+**: [![Light's Potential](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_alchemy_lightpotion_yellow.gif)Light's Potential![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241308/lights-potential)


### Demonology Warlock Health Potions

The best healing potion for Demonology Warlocks is [![Silvermoon Health Potion](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_alchemy_lightpotion_orange.gif)Silvermoon Health Potion![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241304/silvermoon-health-potion).

### Demonology Warlock Weapon Buff

For their weapons, Demonology Warlocks will always use [![Thalassian Phoenix Oil](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_enchanting_manaoil_red.gif)Thalassian Phoenix Oil![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=243734/thalassian-phoenix-oil).

### Demonology Warlock Augment Rune

The new Augment Rune is [![Void-Touched Augment Rune](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_10_enchanting_crystal_color2.gif)Void-Touched Augment Rune](https://www.wowhead.com/item=259085/void-touched-augment-rune).

### Demonology Warlock Food

Demonology Warlocks are most likely using personal stat food over feast buffs as we value the baseline Intellect more than secondaries. As always, sim your character to check which food is the best for your configuration of secondary stats.

- Feast: [![Silvermoon Parade](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_tradeskill_cooking_feastofblood.gif)Silvermoon Parade](https://www.wowhead.com/item=255845/silvermoon-parade)

- Personal Food: [![Royal Roast](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_cooking_100_roastduck.gif)Royal Roast](https://www.wowhead.com/item=242275/royal-roast)

Our primary resource is [![Soul Shards](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_misc_gem_amethyst_02.gif)Soul Shards](https://www.wowhead.com/resource/soul-shards-7), which we both generate and spend with several abilities in our kit. We can choose to either spend them on [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_chaosbolt.gif)Chaos Bolt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=116858/chaos-bolt), a single-target ability, or on [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_rainoffire.gif)Rain of Fire](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=42223/rain-of-fire), an AoE ability that deals damage over time. Destruction deals its damage in big hits and doesn't rely on pets doing the dirty work for us. That's still the case to this day, although we've become known for our signature cooldown, [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_summoninfernal.gif)Summon Infernal](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1122/summon-infernal), creating a powerful companion when summoned. ## ~~~~ Destruction Warlock Strengths and Weaknesses Destruction plays with different setups in raids and Mythic+ content and thus has somewhat different strengths and weaknesses, depending on the situation. For this reason, I have split up the spec's strengths and weaknesses into different categories: **Destruction Warlock in raids** and **Destruction Warlock in Mythic+**. ### Destruction Warlock in Raids | | | | | --- | --- | --- | | **Strengths** | | **Weaknesses** | | - Great cleave with [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_baneofhavoc.gif)Havoc](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=80240/havoc)/ [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_warlock_demonbolt.gif)Mayhem](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=387506/mayhem).

- Good mobility when playing with [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_scourgebuild.gif)Shadowburn](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=17877/shadowburn).

- Decent defensives against burst damage with [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_demonictactics.gif)Unending Resolve](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=104773/unending-resolve) and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_deathpact.gif)Dark Pact](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=108416/dark-pact).

- Provides good utility to your party or raid with [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_shadesofdarkness.gif)Create Soulwell](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=29893/create-soulwell), [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_warlock_demonicportal_green.gif)Demonic Gateway](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=111771/demonic-gateway), [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_soulgem.gif)Soulstone](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=20707/soulstone), and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv12_ability_warlock_ritualofsummoning.gif)Ritual of Summoning](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=698/ritual-of-summoning). | | - Mediocre single-target output.

- Weak defensives against rot damage. | ### Destruction Warlock in Mythic+ | | | | | --- | --- | --- | | **Strengths** | | **Weaknesses** | | - Great priority target swap damage for new adds.

- Great sustained AoE damage with big pulls, where mobs might be alive for a longer time.

- Destruction is not hindered by any diminishing returns on AoE. We gain equal power with each additional target, making the spec one of the most potent sources of AoE damage in the game.

- Provides good utility to your party or raid with [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_shadesofdarkness.gif)Create Soulwell](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=29893/create-soulwell), [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_warlock_demonicportal_green.gif)Demonic Gateway](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=111771/demonic-gateway), and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_soulgem.gif)Soulstone](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=20707/soulstone). | | - Weaker on smaller pulls because we have a longer ramp time than other specs.

- Doesn't have burst AoE compared to a lot of other specs, such as Demonology.

- Weak defensives against rot damage. | ## ~~~~ Destruction Warlock Cheat Sheet ![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/logos/wh-logo-thumbnail.png)WowheadDestruction WarlockRaidMythic+Open
