talents have been redesigned, some quite significantly: - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_inferno.gif)Roaring Blaze](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=205184/roaring-blaze) now speads [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_immolation.gif)Immolate](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=348/immolate) on up to 3 targets when casting [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_fireball.gif)Conflagrate](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=17962/conflagrate). - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_scourgebuild.gif)Shadowburn](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=17877/shadowburn) is now only usable on targets below 20% hp. The cooldown has been removed, and shard costs have been reduced to 1. - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_misc_volatilefire.gif)Blistering Atrophy](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=456939/blistering-atrophy) now increases Shadowburn Critical Strike chance to 100%. - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_warlock_demonicportal_purple.gif)Dimensional Rift](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=387976/dimensional-rift) is now a passive that gives your single-target soul shard spenders [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_scourgebuild.gif)Shadowburn](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=17877/shadowburn) and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_chaosbolt.gif)Chaos Bolt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=116858/chaos-bolt) a chance to summon a dimensional rift. - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_firebolt.gif)Soul Fire](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=6353/soul-fire) is now a choice node with [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_warlock_demonicportal_purple.gif)Dimensional Rift](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=387976/dimensional-rift). - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv12_ability_warlock_overfiend.gif)Avatar of Destruction](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1245089/avatar-of-destruction) has been redesigned. It now has a chance to summon an Overfiend instead of the portal summoned by Dimensional Rift, or summons an overfiend whenever you cast [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_firebolt.gif)Soul Fire](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=6353/soul-fire). - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_scourgebuild.gif)Conflagration of Chaos](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=387108/conflagration-of-chaos) has been redesigned to now allow Shadowburn to be cast regardless of the target's hit points, as well as being a guaranteed Critical Strike. This also scales with your Critical Strike chance. ## Destruction Warlock Hero Talents: Hellcaller and Diabolist For Hero Talents, Destruction Warlocks have to pick between Hellcaller and Diabolist. Hellcaller changes [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_immolation.gif)Immolate](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=348/immolate) into [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_ability_hellcallerwarlock_wither.gif)Wither](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=445468/wither) and further interacts with this DoT to deal extra damage and buff your own character. Hellcaller is strong on spread cleave as well as heavy AoE, where you can apply Wither with [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/achievement_zone_cataclysm.gif)Cataclysm](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=152108/cataclysm) and deal large amounts of damage to multiple targets that survive for longer. Diabolist deals extra damage from summoning demons passively through our regular rotation whenever we spend [![Soul Shards](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_misc_gem_amethyst_02.gif)Soul Shards](https://www.wowhead.com/resource/soul-shards-7). [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/ability_marksmanship.jpg)Talent Builds](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warlock/destruction/talent-builds-pve-dps) ## ~~~~ Playing a Destruction Warlock in Midnight Season 1 ## ~~~~ How to Play Destruction Warlock | | | | --- | --- | | Destruction excels at dealing large hits through [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_chaosbolt.gif)Chaos Bolt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=116858/chaos-bolt) and very strong cleave damage through [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_baneofhavoc.gif)Havoc](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=80240/havoc). Destruction is by nature a relatively simple spec to play, but with a different [![Soul Shards](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_misc_gem_amethyst_02.gif)Soul Shards](https://www.wowhead.com/resource/soul-shards-7) system than Affliction and Demonology, the playstyle is quite different. * * * | | | | --- | --- | | ~~~~ | **Do not overcap on Soul Shards -** Soul Shards are your resource and are limited to a max of 5. Destruction's Soul Shards resource is different from Affliction and Demonology, as all our shards are split into 10 Soul Shard fragments. We have great control over generating and spending this resource, so make sure you're aware of having Soul Shards when you need them, while not wasting any Soul Shards by overcapping. | * * * | | | | --- | --- | | ~~~~ | **Managing cooldowns -** Properly managing your cooldowns, such as [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_baneofhavoc.gif)Havoc](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=80240/havoc) and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_summoninfernal.gif)Summon Infernal](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1122/summon-infernal), will make a big difference in how much damage you're doing. Making sure you have the correct amount of Soul Shards before using these, and making sure you don't lose out on any uses, is a big difference maker between high DPS and low DPS. | * * * | | | | --- | --- | | ~~~~ | **Movement -** When you're moving around, you only have very few ways to deal damage. You can play around with always casting abilities such as [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_fireball.gif)Conflagrate](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=17962/conflagrate) while running, but odds are you're going to lose out on DPS. Playing movement segments correctly will be a big difference maker. Using abilities like [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_demoniccirclesummon.gif)Demonic Circle](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=48018/demonic-circle) and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_warlock_demonicportal_green.gif)Demonic Gateway](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=111771/demonic-gateway) properly will help you with that. | | [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/spell_mekkatorque_bot_bluegear.jpg)Rotation](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warlock/destruction/rotation-cooldowns-pve-dps) [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/inv_112_achievement_raid_manaforgeomega.jpg)Raid Tips](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warlock/destruction/manaforge-omega-raid-tips) [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/inv_relics_hourglass.jpg)Mythic+](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warlock/destruction/mythic-plus-dungeon-tips) ## ~~~~ Gearing a Destruction Warlock in Midnight Season 1 As a general guideline, follow the stat priority of: **Haste = Critical Strike > Mastery > Versatility**. Don't neglect the value of **Intellect**, as a substantial increase in item level is typically going to be worth it compared to optimized stats. It is always recommended that you use [Raidbots](https://www.raidbots.com/simbot/stats) to sim your own character, since every character is different. [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/inv_chest_chain_03.jpg)Best-in-Slot Gear](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warlock/destruction/bis-gear) ## ~~~~ What Professions are Best for Destruction Warlock? Compared to previous expansions, professions in Midnight provide minimal benefits towards the performance of your spec. This means that Destruction Warlock players can choose any profession according to personal preference. You might consider [Tailoring](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/midnight/professions/tailoring-overview-trainer-locations-recipes-tools) to craft your own armor, as many profession items can be very close to your [Best in Slot gear](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warlock/destruction/bis-gear). On the other hand, you may opt for [Alchemy](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/midnight/professions/alchemy-overview-trainer-locations-recipes-tools) to craft consumables or [Enchanting](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/midnight/professions/enchanting-overview-trainer-locations-recipes-tools) to enchant gear without relying on the Auction House. [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/inv_inscription_80_warscroll_intellect.jpg)Stats](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warlock/destruction/stat-priority-pve-dps) [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/ui_concentration.jpg)Professions in Midnight](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/professions/overview) ## ~~~~ What Race is Best for Destruction Warlock? Both Horde and Alliance Destruction Warlocks can be any race. The difference between races is very small now compared to earlier expansions, so I recommend choosing based on personal preference. If you were to make a decision based solely on racial performance, I would suggest going **Dwarf** for Alliance and **Tauren** or **Orc** for Horde. These races have the strongest passive damage increase racials, as well as strong active defensive racials. * * * Our Destruction Warlock guides are always updated with the latest information from in-game experience, simulations, and logs. # Destruction Warlock DPS Basics - Starter Guide for Midnight

[By Loozy](https://www.wowhead.com/author/Loozy)
Updated:
2026/02/24

Welcome to our Destruction Warlock starter guide, which covers everything you need to start playing a new character in Midnight. While our other guide pages go into more detail about individual aspects of Destruction Warlock gameplay, this simple starter guide covers all the basics in one place.

Visit the complete Destruction Warlock guide pages linked in the navigation on the left-hand side of the page for more in-depth information!

[Overview](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warlock/destruction/overview-pve-dps) [BiS Gear](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warlock/destruction/bis-gear) [Rotation](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warlock/destruction/rotation-cooldowns-pve-dps) [Talent Builds](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warlock/destruction/talent-builds-pve-dps) [Consumables](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warlock/destruction/enchants-gems-pve-dps) [Stats](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warlock/destruction/stat-priority-pve-dps) [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/large/inv_misc_groupneedmore.jpg)\\

## ~~~~ Talent Build for Destruction Warlock Beginners

Destruction is a very simple spec, so when getting started as a Destruction Warlock, I recommend going with the default single-target/cleave build. The only change between these is whether or not you have [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_baneofhavoc.gif)Havoc](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=80240/havoc). This build works for both Diabolist and Hellcaller, but this import code is for Diabolist as that is technically the better option of the two for single target situations.

If you're looking for more in-depth builds or explanations regarding talents choices, check out our Talent Builds guide:

## ~~~~ Rotation Priority for Destruction Warlock Beginners

This is a very "down to the bone" rundown of the Destruction rotation. For more in-depth, as well as some slightly more advanced tips, visit the [Destruction Warlock Rotation Guide](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warlock/destruction/rotation-cooldowns-pve-dps).

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| |     |     |
| --- | --- |
| ~~~~ | **Soul Shards** We generate [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_misc_gem_amethyst_02.gif)Soul Shard](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=281592/soul-shard) through our rotation with [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_immolation.gif)Immolate](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=348/immolate), [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_burnout.gif)Incinerate](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=29722/incinerate) and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_fireball.gif)Conflagrate](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=17962/conflagrate). |

* * *

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| ~~~~ | **Spenders:** Spend [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_misc_gem_amethyst_02.gif)Soul Shard](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=281592/soul-shard) either with [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_chaosbolt.gif)Chaos Bolt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=116858/chaos-bolt) on single-target or [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_rainoffire.gif)Rain of Fire](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=5740/rain-of-fire) on AoE. |

* * *

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| ~~~~ | **Cooldowns:** [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_summoninfernal.gif)Summon Infernal](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1122/summon-infernal) is our big cooldown. During this cooldown, we deal extra damage and generate extra soul shards. | |

### Single Button Rotation Assistant

Assisted Highlight and Single-Button Assistant are two new tools designed to assist players with general combat rotation and how their class spells and abilities influence one another. For Destruction Warlock, these tools will help you learn the basics of the class, but fall short due to their lack of cooldown usage. It is recommended to learn the rotation on your own once you have a general grasp on how the spec plays.

If you do use the rotation assistant, make sure you cast your cooldowns such as [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_summoninfernal.gif)Summon Infernal](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1122/summon-infernal) on your own.

# Destruction Warlock Abilities and Talents Guide - Midnight

[By Loozy](https://www.wowhead.com/author/Loozy)
Updated:
2026/02/25

Explore the depths of the Destruction Warlock talent tree, which contains the bulk of your abilities and customization options. In this Destruction Warlock guide, we review all the different abilities and talents in **Midnight Season 1**, including an explanation for what they do and how to use them correctly.

[Overview](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warlock/destruction/overview-pve-dps) [BiS Gear](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warlock/destruction/bis-gear) [Rotation](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warlock/destruction/rotation-cooldowns-pve-dps) [Talent Builds](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warlock/destruction/talent-builds-pve-dps) [Consumables](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warlock/destruction/enchants-gems-pve-dps) [Stats](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warlock/destruction/stat-priority-pve-dps) [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/large/inv_misc_groupneedmore.jpg)\\
Basics](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warlock/destruction/basics)

Show Table of Contents

## ~~~~ Baseline Destruction Warlock Spells

### ~~~~ Offensive Abilities

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_immolation.gif)Immolate](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=348/immolate) **(Immo)** \- A casted dot that deals fire damage and generates 1 soul shard fragment per tick, and has a 50% chance to generate an additional soul shard fragment on critical strikes.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_burnout.gif)Incinerate](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=29722/incinerate) \- Our primary filler, and single target soul shard generator that generates 2 soul shard fragments, and an additional 1 on critical strikes.

- (talent) [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_chaosbolt.gif)Chaos Bolt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=116858/chaos-bolt) **(CB)**\- Longer cast soul shard spender, that costs 2 soul shards to cast. [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_chaosbolt.gif)Chaos Bolt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=116858/chaos-bolt) always crits, and has its damage further increased based on your critical strike chance.

- (talent) [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_fireball.gif)Conflagrate](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=17962/conflagrate) \- **(Conflag)** \- Instant cast ability that deals damage and generates 5 soul shard fragments, as well as grants a stack of [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_backdraft.gif)Backdraft](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=196406/backdraft).


### ~~~~ Offensive Cooldowns

While all of our offensive cooldowns are found in the talent tree, I still thought it relevant to cover them briefly here:

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_summoninfernal.gif)Summon Infernal](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1122/summon-infernal) \- Summons an infernal for 30 seconds that deals damage and generates extra soul shard fragments while active.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_baneofhavoc.gif)Havoc](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=80240/havoc) \- Apples a curse to a target that copies all of your single-target abilities onto another target for 60% efficiency. This is also found in the passive proc version [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_warlock_demonbolt.gif)Mayhem](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=387506/mayhem).


### ~~~~ Defensive Cooldowns

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_demonictactics.gif)Unending Resolve](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=104773/unending-resolve) **(UR)** \- Shield wall effect, granting you damage reduction and immunity to spell cast interrupts.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_lifedrain02.gif)Drain Life](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=234153/drain-life) \- Drains life from your target and restores it to you.


### ~~~~ Utility Abilities

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_possession.gif)Fear](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=5782/fear) \- Fears a target in a random direction.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_curseofmannoroth.gif)Curse of Weakness](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=702/curse-of-weakness) **(CoW)** \- Debuff applied to an enemy mob, increasing the time between their attacks.

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_warlock_demonbolt.gif)Mayhem](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=387506/mayhem) \- Single target spells have a chance to apply [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_baneofhavoc.gif)Havoc](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=80240/havoc) to a nearby enemy target for a short period.


- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_burningsoul.gif)Scalding Flames](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=388832/scalding-flames) \- Increases the damage and duration of [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_immolation.gif)Immolate](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=348/immolate).


#### Row 5 Talents

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_scourgebuild.gif)Shadowburn](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=17877/shadowburn) \- Instant cast soul shard spender that costs 1 soul shard, and can only be used on enemies below 20% health. If the target dies within 5 seconds of [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_scourgebuild.gif)Shadowburn](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=17877/shadowburn) being cast, the soul shard is refunded.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_playingwithfire.gif)Backlash](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=387384/backlash) \- Increases your critical strike chance, and gives physical attacks against you a chance to make your next [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_burnout.gif)Incinerate](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=29722/incinerate) cast instant.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_baneofhavoc.gif)Improved Havoc](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1244460/improved-havoc) \- Increases the duration of [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_baneofhavoc.gif)Havoc](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=80240/havoc), and increases the damage they take from you by an additional 10%. This increased duration does not work for [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_warlock_demonbolt.gif)Mayhem](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=387506/mayhem).

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_enchanting_dust.gif)Ashen Remains](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=387252/ashen-remains) \- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_burnout.gif)Incinerate](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=29722/incinerate), [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_chaosbolt.gif)Chaos Bolt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=116858/chaos-bolt) and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_scourgebuild.gif)Shadowburn](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=17877/shadowburn) deal increased damage to targets afflicted by [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_immolation.gif)Immolate](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=348/immolate).

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/achievement_zone_cataclysm.gif)Cataclysm](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=152108/cataclysm) \- Deals damage at a target location and affects enemies hit with [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_immolation.gif)Immolate](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=348/immolate).


#### Row 6 Talents

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_soulburn.gif)Fiendish Cruelty](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1245633/fiendish-cruelty) \- When your [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_chaosbolt.gif)Chaos Bolt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=116858/chaos-bolt), [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_fireball.gif)Conflagrate](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=17962/conflagrate) and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_burnout.gif)Incinerate](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=29722/incinerate) crits, they have a chance to make your next [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_scourgebuild.gif)Shadowburn](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=17877/shadowburn) cast cost no soul shard and be usable regardless of the targets health.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_burnout.gif)Chaotic Inferno](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1244788/chaotic-inferno) \- Increases [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_chaosbolt.gif)Chaos Bolt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=116858/chaos-bolt) damage by 5%, and makes your [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_chaosbolt.gif)Chaos Bolt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=116858/chaos-bolt) cast have a chance to make your next [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_burnout.gif)Incinerate](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=29722/incinerate) instant cast.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_moltenblood.gif)Flashpoint](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=387259/flashpoint) \- When [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_immolation.gif)Immolate](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=348/immolate) deals periodic damage to a target above 80% health, gain a stacking haste buff for 10 seconds. This effect stacks up to 3 times.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_summoninfernal.gif)Summon Infernal](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1122/summon-infernal) \- Our 2 minute cooldown that summons an infernal for 30 seconds, that deals damage and generates 1 soul shard fragment every 0.5 seconds while active.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_selfdestruct.gif)Emberstorm](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=454744/emberstorm) \- Grants a flat damage increase to your fire spells, as well as reducing the cast time of [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_burnout.gif)Incinerate](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=29722/incinerate).

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_fireandbrimstone.gif)Fire and Brimstone](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=196408/fire-and-brimstone) \- Makes [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_burnout.gif)Incinerate](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=29722/incinerate) cleave onto all enemies near your target for 25% damage.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_ragnaros_molteninferno.gif)Lake of Fire](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1244877/lake-of-fire) \- Your [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/achievement_zone_cataclysm.gif)Cataclysm](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=152108/cataclysm) now leaves behind a a fire circle where you cast it. This circle deals damage, and makes [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_immolation.gif)Immolate](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=348/immolate) deal increased damage to enemies within the circle.


#### Row 7 Talents

- Choice node:

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_playingwithfiregreen.gif)Reverse Entropy](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=205148/reverse-entropy) \- Your spells have a chance to grant you a haste buff.

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_mage_livingbomb.gif)Internal Combustion](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=266134/internal-combustion) \- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_chaosbolt.gif)Chaos Bolt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=116858/chaos-bolt) consumes some of [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_immolation.gif)Immolate](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=348/immolate)'s damage over time effect instantly dealing that much damage.


- Choice node:

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_infernalmount.gif)Crashing Chaos](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=417234/crashing-chaos) \- Casting [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_summoninfernal.gif)Summon Infernal](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1122/summon-infernal) increases the damage of your next 8 casts of [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_chaosbolt.gif)Chaos Bolt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=116858/chaos-bolt) or [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_rainoffire.gif)Rain of Fire](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=5740/rain-of-fire).

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_felrainoffire.gif)Rain of Chaos](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=266086/rain-of-chaos) \- While [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_summoninfernal.gif)Summon Infernal](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1122/summon-infernal) is active, every soul shard you spend has a chance to summon an additional infernal.


- Choice node:

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_unsummonbuilding.gif)Summoner's Embrace](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=453105/summoners-embrace) \- Increases the damage dealt by your spells and your demon.

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warlock_grimoireofsacrifice.gif)Grimoire of Sacrifice](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=108503/grimoire-of-sacrifice) \- Sacrifice your demon, gaining its command demon ability and causing your spells to sometimes deal extra shadow damage.


#### Row 8 Talents

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_shadowwordpain.gif)Ruin](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=387103/ruin) \- Increases the critical strike damage of your destruction spells.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_chaosbolt.gif)Improved Chaos Bolt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=456951/improved-chaos-bolt) \- Increases the damage and reduces the cast time of [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_chaosbolt.gif)Chaos Bolt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=116858/chaos-bolt).

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_rainoffire.gif)Destructive Rapidity](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1244928/destructive-rapidity) \- Increases how quickly [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_rainoffire.gif)Rain of Fire](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=5740/rain-of-fire) and your [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_summoninfernal.gif)Summon Infernal](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1122/summon-infernal)'s imolation deals its damage.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_flameshock.gif)Devastation](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=454735/devastation) \- Increases the critical strike chance of your destruction spells.


#### Row 9 Talents

- Choice node:

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_artifact_dimensionalrift.gif)Dimensional Rift](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1280868/dimensional-rift) \- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_chaosbolt.gif)Chaos Bolt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=116858/chaos-bolt) and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_scourgebuild.gif)Shadowburn](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=17877/shadowburn) casts have a chance to open a rift that deals damage to your target. This rift also generates 1 full soul shard over its duration.

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_firebolt.gif)Soul Fire](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=6353/soul-fire) \- A longer cast that deals damage, applies [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_immolation.gif)Immolate](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=348/immolate) and generates 1 soul shard


- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warlock_pvp_burninglegion.gif)Inferno](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1280483/inferno) \- Reduces the cooldown of [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_summoninfernal.gif)Summon Infernal](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1122/summon-infernal) by 30 seconds, making it a 1m30s cooldown. Additionally, your mastery is increased by 3%.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_scourgebuild.gif)Conflagration of Chaos](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=387108/conflagration-of-chaos) \- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_scourgebuild.gif)Shadowburn](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=17877/shadowburn) and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_fireball.gif)Conflagrate](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=17962/conflagrate) have a chance to make your next use of the ability a guaranteed crit, and increase its damage by your critical strike chance.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_shoulder_robe_raidmage_j_01.gif)Diabolic Embers](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=387173/diabolic-embers) \- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_burnout.gif)Incinerate](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=29722/incinerate) generates 100% additional soul shard fragments.

- Choice node:

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_ragnaros_lavaboltgreen.gif)Channel Demonfire](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=196447/channel-demonfire) \- Channeled ability that deals damage to targets affected by your [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_immolation.gif)Immolate](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=348/immolate).

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_shadowandflame.gif)Demonfire Infusion](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1214442/demonfire-infusion) \- Your [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_immolation.gif)Immolate](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=348/immolate) periodic damage, and your [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_burnout.gif)Incinerate](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=29722/incinerate) has a chance to fire a demonfire bolt at your target.


#### Capstones

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv12_ability_warlock_overfiend.gif)Avatar of Destruction](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1245089/avatar-of-destruction) \- Whenever you cast a [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_firebolt.gif)Soul Fire](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=6353/soul-fire) you summon an overfiend. When you summon a [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_artifact_dimensionalrift.gif)Dimensional Rift](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1280868/dimensional-rift), you have a chance to instead summon an overfiend.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_felflamering.gif)Chaos Incarnate](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=387275/chaos-incarnate) \- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_chaosbolt.gif)Chaos Bolt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=116858/chaos-bolt), [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_rainoffire.gif)Rain of Fire](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=5740/rain-of-fire) and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_scourgebuild.gif)Shadowburn](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=17877/shadowburn) always benefit from at least 70% of the maximum effect from our mastery.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_ironmaidens_rapidfire.gif)Alythess's Ire](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1244941/alythesss-ire) \- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_rainoffire.gif)Rain of Fire](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=5740/rain-of-fire) has a 20% chance to make your next [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_rainoffire.gif)Rain of Fire](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=5740/rain-of-fire) within 8 seconds free.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_ragnaros_lavaboltgreen.gif)Raging Demonfire](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=387166/raging-demonfire) \- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_ragnaros_lavaboltgreen.gif)Channel Demonfire](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=196447/channel-demonfire) and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_shadowandflame.gif)Demonfire Infusion](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1214442/demonfire-infusion) fires an additional bolt or bolts, and each bolt increases the remaining duration of your [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_immolation.gif)Immolate](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=348/immolate) on the target.

Having the right distribution of stats on your gear can be critical towards optimizing your performance. to diminishing returns. This means that adding more of the same stat beyond certain thresholds results in reduced benefits. These thresholds are fixed and reduce the amount gained from more of that stat rating by 10% per breakpoint. Each stat has a different rating threshold where the reduction begins: - **Critical Strike** \- Above 1380 rating - **Haste** \- Above 1320 rating - **Mastery** \- Above 1380 rating - **Versatility** \- Above 1620 rating **Example** Let's assume you gain 1% Haste for 10 Haste Rating. When above the diminishing return breakpoint, 10 Haste Rating would give you 0.9% Haste instead, resulting in a 10% reduction from what you gained previously. Note that this system **only counts stat rating**, meaning that percentage-based procs and effects like [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_nature_bloodlust.gif)Bloodlust](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=2825/bloodlust) aren't factored in and will always grant their full benefit. ## Destruction Warlock Rotation in The War Within

Destruction excels at dealing large hits through [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_chaosbolt.gif)Chaos Bolt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=116858/chaos-bolt) and very strong cleave damage through [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_baneofhavoc.gif)Havoc](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=80240/havoc). Destruction is by nature a relatively simple spec to play, but with a different [![Soul Shards](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_misc_gem_amethyst_02.gif)Soul Shards](https://www.wowhead.com/resource/soul-shards-7) system than Affliction and Demonology, the playstyle is quite different.

When playing Destruction, your rotation includes:

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| |     |     |
| --- | --- |
| ~~~~ | **Soul Shard management** Do not overcap Soul Shards. Destruction's Soul Shards resource is different than Affliction and Demonology, as all our shards are split into 10 soul shard fragments. We have great control over generating and spending this resource, so make sure you're aware of having Soul Shards when you need them, while not wasting any Soul Shards by overcapping. |

* * *

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| ~~~~ | **Cooldown management:** Being able to properly manage your cooldowns, such as [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_baneofhavoc.gif)Havoc](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=80240/havoc) and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_summoninfernal.gif)Summon Infernal](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1122/summon-infernal) will make a big difference in how much damage you're doing. Making sure you have the correct amount of Soul Shards before using these, and making sure you don't lose out on any uses, is a big difference maker between high DPS and low DPS. |

* * *

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| ~~~~ | **Movement:** When you're moving around, you only have very few ways to deal damage. You can play around with always casting abilities such as [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_fireball.gif)Conflagrate](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=17962/conflagrate) while running, but odds are you're going to lose out on DPS. That means, playing movement segments correctly will be a big difference maker. Utilizing abilities like [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_demoniccirclesummon.gif)Demonic Circle](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=48018/demonic-circle) and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_warlock_demonicportal_green.gif)Demonic Gateway](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=111771/demonic-gateway) properly will help you with that. | |

If you're looking for a more bite-sized rotation explanation, check out our simplified guide below:

[![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/spell_shadow_rainoffire.jpg)Destruction Warlock Starter Guide](https://www.wowhead.com/guide=33013)

If you're playing Hellcaller. you want to cast [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_rainoffire.gif)Rain of Fire](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=5740/rain-of-fire) if there are 5+ targets up and you have [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_baneofhavoc.gif)Havoc](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=80240/havoc) active. If [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_baneofhavoc.gif)Havoc](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=80240/havoc) is not up, you spend soul shards with [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_rainoffire.gif)Rain of Fire](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=5740/rain-of-fire) on 3+ targets.

If [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_baneofhavoc.gif)Havoc](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=80240/havoc) is active, you spend soul shards with [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_chaosbolt.gif)Chaos Bolt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=116858/chaos-bolt) on up to 5 targets. Otherwise, you should only spend soul shards with [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_chaosbolt.gif)Chaos Bolt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=116858/chaos-bolt) on 1-2 targets.

Diabolist always spends soul shards on [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_chaosbolt.gif)Chaos Bolt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=116858/chaos-bolt) no matter what.

## Pre-Combat Check

Before any combat happens, it is important for Destruction Warlock to make sure the following are done. This applies to raids, dungeons, delves, or even open-world content.

- **Get your food buff and oil applied!**

- **Summon your Pet!**

- **Drop healthstones! -** Cast [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_shadesofdarkness.gif)Create Soulwell](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=29893/create-soulwell) for every party/raid member to get a [![Healthstone](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warlock_-healthstone.gif)Healthstone](https://www.wowhead.com/item=5512/healthstone)

- **Portals, portals everywhere! -** As needed, make sure your portals are down in an appropriate location. This includes both personal, [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_demoniccirclesummon.gif)Demonic Circle](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=268358/demonic-circle) and group, [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_warlock_demonicportal_green.gif)Demonic Gateway](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=111771/demonic-gateway) portals.

- **Double Check your Talents! -** Have another quick look to make sure you are in the correct talents for the boss, and you can't see any changes that might help.


## ~~~~ Single Button Rotation Assistant Losses for Destruction Warlock

Destruction has a relatively simple rotation that works by generating Soul Shards and spending that resource on damage-dealing spells. Compared to other DPS specs, we have a lower number of main abilities in our rotation. For this reason, the rotational tool might not actually be that horrible percentagewise compared to a lot of other specs. That being said, using the rotational tool is not going to be the way you get the most out of your character, but for a casual player just running through non challenging content you will be able to get away with using it.

### Rotation Assist Losses for Destruction Warlock

When using the Rotation Assist, you can expect the following losses when compared to performing your rotation yourself:

**Single Target**

- Assisted Highlight: About **~3.8% DPS Loss**

- Single-Button Assistant: About **~10.4% DPS Loss**


**Note -** These numbers assume the player manually casts [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_summoninfernal.gif)Summon Infernal](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1122/summon-infernal), which is not being highlighted by neither the rotation assist or the single-button helper. If you do not manually remember to use [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_summoninfernal.gif)Summon Infernal](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1122/summon-infernal), your DPS loss is going to be significantly higher.

**AoE**

- Assisted Highlight: About **~11% DPS Loss**

- Single-Button Assistant: About **~14% DPS Loss**


**Note -** For AoE it's a little hard deciding what to expect. It's going to vary heavily on wether or not you manually pop your [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_summoninfernal.gif)Summon Infernal](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1122/summon-infernal) and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_baneofhavoc.gif)Havoc](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=80240/havoc), because the helper does not do this. The numbers above assume neither of these are manually popped on AoE, so if you do manually pop them regardless you can expect a lower DPS loss.

## ~~~~Destruction Warlock Major Cooldown Usage

Destruction has a number of both big and small cooldowns that are important to know how to play in order to succeed.

Summon Infernal

Havoc

Diabolist Demons

Malevolence

[![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_summoninfernal.gif)Summon Infernal](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1122/summon-infernal) is our 2-minute cooldown that helps us generate more Soul Shards during its duration. Some things to keep in mind when using your infernal is:

- If you're playing [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_infernalmount.gif)Crashing Chaos](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=417234/crashing-chaos), your Infernal cast also makes your damage more important. It's not only a point and click cooldown that does damage on its own; make sure you pair this up with any racial ability and trinkets if you can.

- Keep in mind you can delay this cooldown as long as you don't miss out on uses. During a Mythic+ dungeon you will likely want to pop this as often as possible because you will lose out on uses otherwise, but popping it at the correct time is important.


I have already covered [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_baneofhavoc.gif)Havoc](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=80240/havoc) very thoroughly in this guide, but I will just recap the important points here:

- Keep in mind you can generate 2x Soul Shards with [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_baneofhavoc.gif)Havoc](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=80240/havoc) while your spenders don't cost extra.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_baneofhavoc.gif)Havoc](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=80240/havoc) only replicates 60% of the damage of your single-target abilities, meaning you should apply this to the less important target.

- Make sure your target is going to live for the full [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_baneofhavoc.gif)Havoc](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=80240/havoc) duration if possible.


When playing Diabolist Destruction, you can gain a good portion of damage by knowing what each of the demons summoned by the hero talent tree does:

Because of the talent [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_bossfellord_felspike.gif)Touch of Rancora](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=429893/touch-of-rancora), and because of how Diabolist Destruction works, you want to trigger your demons by casting a [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_chaosbolt.gif)Chaos Bolt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=116858/chaos-bolt). This is unless you're in a situation where you're damaging a LOT of targets, and in that situation you should probably be playing Hellcaller.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_creature_felfrenzy.gif)Demonic Art: Overlord](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=428524/demonic-art-overlord) \- Charges your target and does a frontal cleave. Enemies hit by this cleave then takes increased damage from you and your demons because of the talent [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_creature_felfrenzy.gif)Cloven Souls](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=428517/cloven-souls). If the target you cast on to trigger the [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_creature_felfrenzy.gif)Demonic Art: Overlord](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=428524/demonic-art-overlord) dies before the overlord reaches the target, it instead swaps to a different target and hits that one. Keep this in mind, because if you're damaging a lot of targets, try not to trigger this onto a target that is standing alone. Try to aim this into a big pack for the most damage. Also, keep in mind your damage is increased to targets hit by this for 15 seconds, so try to hit those targets.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/achievement_boss_argus_shivan.gif)Demonic Art: Mother of Chaos](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=432794/demonic-art-mother-of-chaos) \- Summons next to you and starts channelling damage into your target. Additionally, triggering this demonic art changes your next [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_burnout.gif)Incinerate](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=29722/incinerate) into [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fel_firebolt.gif)Infernal Bolt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=434506/infernal-bolt) which deals increased damage and generates 2 full Soul Shards. Make sure you do not overcap on Soul Shards by casting this. Instead, cast [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_chaosbolt.gif)Chaos Bolt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=116858/chaos-bolt) to go down to at least 2,5 Soul Shards, but ideally below 2 Soul Shards before casting [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fel_firebolt.gif)Infernal Bolt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=434506/infernal-bolt). Also, the abilitiy [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/achievement_boss_argus_shivan.gif)Demonic Art: Mother of Chaos](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=432794/demonic-art-mother-of-chaos) casts when summoned is a channelled AoE, which might not always start rechannelling onto a new target if the target dies during this channel. For that reason, try to cast this onto a target that's going to live for the full duration.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_bossmannoroth_empoweredmannorothsgaze.gif)Demonic Art: Pit Lord](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=432795/demonic-art-pit-lord) \- Is also summoned right next to you, and starts dealing pulsating AoE damage onto and around your target. Additionally, triggering this Demonic Art turns your next [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_chaosbolt.gif)Chaos Bolt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=116858/chaos-bolt) into [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_felflamestrike.gif)Ruination](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=434635/ruination). A very powerful AoE around your target. Make sure you cast this on the mob where it's going to hit the most targets possible.


Some extra notes when palying Diabolist is, that you always cycle in the same order. It goes:

1. Overlord

2. Mother of Chaos

3. Pit Lord


This resets on boss combat in raids, but not in dungeons. This means, you can play slower or faster from time to time, depending on what demon you want to summon. As an example, if you're in a dungeon and you're about to finish off a pack, just killing off the last few mobs, and you're about to gain [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_bossmannoroth_empoweredmannorothsgaze.gif)Demonic Art: Pit Lord](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=432795/demonic-art-pit-lord), do not trigger this on that pack. Instead, be a little patient and deal big damage on the next pack. Do not postpone this, because when playing, you do cycle through the rotation of demons fairly quickly. However, it adds a layer of complexity and depth to the playstyle and might ultimately make your damage output significantly higher.

Before pressing [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_ability_hellcallerwarlock_malevolence.gif)Malevolence](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=442726/malevolence), always have all of your [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_ability_hellcallerwarlock_wither.gif)Wither](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=445468/wither) applied. This can happen by you doing a big pull, casting [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/achievement_zone_cataclysm.gif)Cataclysm](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=152108/cataclysm) -\> [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_ragnaros_lavaboltgreen.gif)Channel Demonfire](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=196447/channel-demonfire) and then following it up by [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_ability_hellcallerwarlock_malevolence.gif)Malevolence](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=442726/malevolence) into either [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_chaosbolt.gif)Chaos Bolt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=116858/chaos-bolt) or [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_rainoffire.gif)Rain of Fire](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=5740/rain-of-fire) spam, collapsing your [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_ability_hellcallerwarlock_wither.gif)Wither](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=445468/wither) stacks, dealing damage with [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_nzinsanity_chasedbyshadows.gif)Blackened Soul](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=440043/blackened-soul).

During [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_ability_hellcallerwarlock_malevolence.gif)Malevolence](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=442726/malevolence), all of the [![Soul Shards](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_misc_gem_amethyst_02.gif)Soul Shards](https://www.wowhead.com/resource/soul-shards-7) you cast grants double stacks of [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_ability_hellcallerwarlock_wither.gif)Wither](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=445468/wither) to your targets, so try your very best to have some shards ready before, and make sure you dump as much as you can before [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_ability_hellcallerwarlock_malevolence.gif)Malevolence](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=442726/malevolence) runs out. And be careful not to let your [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_ability_hellcallerwarlock_wither.gif)Wither](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=445468/wither) drop on high stacks.

On 1-3 targets, spend Soul Shards on [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warlock_chaosbolt.gif)Chaos Bolt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=116858/chaos-bolt). On 4+ use [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_rainoffire.gif)Rain of Fire](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=5740/rain-of-fire). This guide will help you master your Arms Warrior in most forms of PvE content in the game, including raids and dungeons. [Overview](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/arms/overview-pve-dps) [BiS Gear](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/arms/bis-gear) [Rotation](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/arms/rotation-cooldowns-pve-dps) [Talent Builds](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/arms/talent-builds-pve-dps) [Consumables](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/arms/enchants-gems-pve-dps) [Stats](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/arms/stat-priority-pve-dps) [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/large/inv_misc_groupneedmore.jpg)\\ Basics](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/arms/basics) Show Table of Contents ## ~~~~ Arms Warrior Overview Arms Warriors are high-intensity damage dealers who specialize in Bleeds, proc gameplay, and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_sword_48.gif)Execute](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=163201/execute) damage. The rotation leads off with a combination of [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_savageblow.gif)Mortal Strike](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=12294/mortal-strike), [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_meleedamage.gif)Overpower](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=7384/overpower), and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_gouge.gif)Rend](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=772/rend), punctuated by periods of burst damage from [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_warbreaker.gif)Colossus Smash](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=167105/colossus-smash), before ending the encounter by way of heavy [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_sword_48.gif)Execute](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=163201/execute) s. Their rotation is quite intensive in both resource generation and spending, leading to spiky gameplay where [![Rage](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_misc_emotionangry.gif)Rage](https://www.wowhead.com/resource/rage-1) quickly fills and empties in large chunks. The trick to carrying this out properly is to spend enough Rage to keep from overcapping while not spending so much that you starve and are unable to fill global cooldowns. Since nearly every ability is a resource spender, Arms Warriors must always plan ahead. ## ~~~~ Arms Warrior Strengths and Weaknesses | | | | | --- | --- | --- | | **Strengths** | | **Weaknesses** | | - Execute damage niche and strong two-target cleave.

- Bursty multi-target cooldowns.

- Strong burst mobility and gap closers.

- Good personal defensive abilities and a raid-wide defensive cooldown. | | - Reliant on Shaman's [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/achievement_raidprimalist_windelemental.gif)Skyfury](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=462854/skyfury) buff to maximize resource generation.

- Very specialized builds, focusing on either single-target or multi-target damage, but rarely both at the same time.

- Very susceptible to downtime due to a lack of ranged abilities or passive resource generation.

- Minimum range restrictions and cooldowns can limit mobility.

- Lack of damage immunity and self-healing. | ## ~~~~ Arms Warrior Cheat Sheet ![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/logos/wh-logo-thumbnail.png)WowheadArms Warrior Raid Warrior Changes in Midnight Arms Warriors have undergone several major talent changes in Midnight, including the removal of some active abilities. ### Removed Abilities - **[Skullsplitter](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=315720)** - **[Bitter Immunity](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=383762)** - **[Thunderous Roar](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=384318)** - **[Warbreaker](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=262161)** (now baked into Colossus Smash) ## Arms Warrior Hero Talents: Colossus and Slayer Arms Warriors have the choice between the Colossus and Slayer Hero Talents, with each introducing their own gameplay elements. - Colossus greatly enhances [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_cleave.gif)Cleave](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=845/cleave) and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_savageblow.gif)Mortal Strike](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=12294/mortal-strike), while gaining an entirely new ability in [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_ability_colossuswarrior_demolish.gif)Demolish](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=436358/demolish). Inspired by [![Fyr'alath the Dreamrender](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_axe_2h_fyrakk_d_01_shadowflame.gif)Fyr'alath the Dreamrender](https://www.wowhead.com/item=206448/fyralath-the-dreamrender), [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_ability_colossuswarrior_demolish.gif)Demolish](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=436358/demolish) is a powerful channeled cast that deals a substantial amount of damage on a short cooldown. To top it off, Colossus Warriors are slightly larger than their counterparts and have access to an automatic heal when near death. - By contrast, Slayer doesn't add anything new to the toolkit, instead greatly enhancing the capability of [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_sword_48.gif)Execute](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=163201/execute) and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_bladestorm.gif)Bladestorm](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=227847/bladestorm), and causing both to be used much more frequently and deal significantly increased damage. Although Slayer lacks compelling defensive benefits, it does feature bonuses to [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_charge.gif)Charge](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=100/charge) and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_heroicleap.gif)Heroic Leap](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=6544/heroic-leap), alongside the long-desired ability to interrupt and stun while channeling Bladestorm. [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/ability_marksmanship.jpg)Talent Builds](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/arms/talent-builds-pve-dps) ## ~~~~ Playing an Arms Warrior in Midnight Season 1 Arms Warriors revolve around using abilities to increase the damage of their attacks, inflict Bleeds, and maximize [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_sword_48.gif)Execute](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=163201/execute) damage. Although the standard rotation is not very complex, there are several synergistic talents that create more complex priorities through their interactions. | | | | --- | --- | | | | | | --- | --- | | ~~~~ | **Avoid Downtime**: Arms generates the majority of its [![Rage](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_misc_emotionangry.gif)Rage](https://www.wowhead.com/resource/rage-1) from auto-attacks, so reducing the amount of time spent chasing targets, running out mechanics, or otherwise not attacking foes is critical towards maximizing performance. There are several abilities to help with this, such as [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_charge.gif)Charge](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=100/charge) and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_heroicleap.gif)Heroic Leap](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=6544/heroic-leap), so use them smartly to stay on your target as much as possible! | * * * | | | | --- | --- | | ~~~~ | **Keep Abilities on cooldown**: Arms generates and spends resources in small amounts, but its ability cooldowns are what really drive the rotation. Aligning various 15, 30, 45, or 90-second cooldowns is crucial, and delaying any one of them can easily cause the others to desync as well, so avoid doing it without good reason - such as a quickly approaching add or increased damage phase. | * * * | | | | --- | --- | | ~~~~ | **Avoid wasting Rage**: Unlike most resources, [![Rage](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_misc_emotionangry.gif)Rage](https://www.wowhead.com/resource/rage-1) starts from zero and decays out of combat. Making efficient use of it, both in combat and by reducing the amount of time spent moving from one combat encounter to the next, will help maintain the rotation and eliminate downtime spent waiting for more resources. | | [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/spell_mekkatorque_bot_bluegear.jpg)Rotation](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/arms/rotation-cooldowns-pve-dps) [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/inv_112_achievement_raid_manaforgeomega.jpg)Raid Tips](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/arms/manaforge-omega-raid-tips) [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/inv_relics_hourglass.jpg)Mythic+](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/arms/mythic-plus-dungeon-tips) ## ~~~~ Gearing an Arms Warrior in Midnight Season 1 As a general guideline, follow the stat priority of: **Critical Strike > Haste > Mastery > Versatility**. Don't neglect the value of **Strength**, as a substantial increase in item level is typically going to be worth it compared to optimized stats. It is always recommended that you use [Raidbots](https://www.raidbots.com/simbot/stats) to sim your own character, since every character is different. [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/inv_chest_chain_03.jpg)Best-in-Slot Gear](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/arms/bis-gear) ## ~~~~ What Professions are Best for Arms Warrior? Compared to previous expansions, professions in Midnight provide minimal benefits towards the performance of your spec. This means that Arms Warrior players can choose any profession according to personal preference. You might consider [Blacksmithing](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/midnight/professions/blacksmithing-overview-trainer-locations-recipes-tools) to craft your own armor, as many profession items can be very close to your [Best in Slot gear](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/arms/bis-gear). On the other hand, you may opt for [Alchemy](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/midnight/professions/alchemy-overview-trainer-locations-recipes-tools) to craft consumables or [Enchanting](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/midnight/professions/enchanting-overview-trainer-locations-recipes-tools) to enchant gear without relying on the Auction House. [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/inv_inscription_80_warscroll_intellect.jpg)Stats](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/arms/stat-priority-pve-dps) [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/ui_concentration.jpg)Professions in Midnight](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/professions/overview) ## ~~~~ What Race is Best for Arms Warrior? Any race can be a Warrior, allowing the greatest number of options, each with its own strengths and special abilities! Unless you desire a specific effect, it's generally recommended to pick a race based on aesthetic preferences, since the performative difference between them tends to be extremely small. Visit the complete Arms Warrior guide pages linked in the navigation on the left-hand side of the page for more in-depth information!

## ~~~~ Rotation Priority for Arms Warrior Beginners

This is a simple example of the spell priorities that make up the basic Arms Warrior rotation. More information about the rotation, as well as an explanation of important abilities and advanced tips can be found in the [Arms Warrior Rotation Guide](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/arms/rotation-cooldowns-pve-dps).

Use [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_warbreaker.gif)Colossus Smash](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=167105/colossus-smash) whenever it is available, keep [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_savageblow.gif)Mortal Strike](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=12294/mortal-strike) and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_cleave.gif)Cleave](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=845/cleave) on cooldown, and fill the rest of the rotation with [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_meleedamage.gif)Overpower](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=7384/overpower) or [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_decisivestrike.gif)Slam](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1464/slam).

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| |     |     |
| --- | --- |
| ~~~~ | **Avoid Downtime** \- Arms generates the majority of its rage from auto-attacks, so reducing the amount of time spent chasing, running out mechanics, or otherwise not hitting the boss is critical to maximizing performance. There are several abilities to help with this, such as [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_charge.gif)Charge](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=100/charge) and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_heroicleap.gif)Heroic Leap](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=6544/heroic-leap), so use them smartly to stay on target as much as possible! |

* * *

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| ~~~~ | **Keep Abilities on cooldown** \- Arms generates and spends resources in small amounts, but its ability cooldowns are what really drive the rotation. Keeping Colossus Smash, Avatar, and Bladestorm/Demolish on cooldown is crucial, as delaying any one of them can easily cause the others to desync as well, so avoid doing it without good reason - such as a quickly approaching add or increased damage phase. |

* * *

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| ~~~~ | **Avoid wasting Rage** \- Unlike most resources, Rage starts from zero and decays out of combat. Making efficient use of it will help maintain the rotation and eliminate downtime spent waiting for more resources, both in combat and by reducing the amount of time spent moving from one combat to another. | |

### Single Button Rotation Assistant

Assisted Highlight and Single-Button Assistant are two new tools designed to assist players with general combat rotation and how their class spells and abilities influence one another. For Arms Warriors, these tools are surprisingly competent and can perform quite well, as long as you are cognizant to use defensive, mobility, and utility abilities on your own.

## ~~~~ Best Stats for Arms Warrior Beginners

Strength is a Warrior's primary stat, increasing the damage of abilities and found on all gear. Critical Strike and Haste increase the pace of gameplay and amount of resources, while Mastery and Versatility are more passive damage increases. For more details, check our [Arms Warrior Stats guide](https://www.wowhead.com/guide=5533).

1. Strength

2. Critical Strike

3. Haste

4. Mastery

# Arms Warrior Abilities and Talents Guide - Midnight

[By Archimtiros](https://www.wowhead.com/author/Archimtiros)
Updated:
2026/02/25

Explore the depths of the Arms Warrior talent tree, which contains the bulk of your abilities and customization options. In this Arms Warrior guide, we review all the different abilities and talents in **Midnight Season 1**, including an explanation for what they do and how to use them correctly.

[Overview](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/arms/overview-pve-dps) [BiS Gear](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/arms/bis-gear) [Rotation](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/arms/rotation-cooldowns-pve-dps) [Talent Builds](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/arms/talent-builds-pve-dps) [Consumables](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/arms/enchants-gems-pve-dps) [Stats](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/arms/stat-priority-pve-dps) [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/large/inv_misc_groupneedmore.jpg)\\
Basics](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/arms/basics)

## ~~~~ Baseline Arms Warrior Abilities

### Offensive Abilities

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_whirlwind.gif)Whirlwind](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=190411/whirlwind) (WW) - primary multitarget attack.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_decisivestrike.gif)Slam](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1464/slam) \- initial rage spender, quickly replaced by other abilities.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_shield_05.gif)Shield Slam](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=23922/shield-slam) \- early offensive ability, replaced upon specializing.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_shockwave.gif)Hamstring](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1715/hamstring) \- minor snare.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_devastate.gif)Victory Rush](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=34428/victory-rush) (VR) - very useful free heal after getting a kill.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_sword_48.gif)Execute](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=163201/execute) (Exe) - Arms' version of Execute

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_axe_66.gif)Heroic Throw](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=57755/heroic-throw) (HT) - pitifully low damage ranged attack, only appropriate for pulling from a distance.


### Utility Abilities

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_charge.gif)Charge](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=100/charge) \- primary mobility and gap closer.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_gauntlets_04.gif)Pummel](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=6552/pummel) \- low cooldown interrupt.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_battleshout.gif)Battle Shout](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=6673/battle-shout) (Shout) - worth ~5% damage for melee classes and Hunters.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_nature_ancestralguardian.gif)Berserker Rage](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=18499/berserker-rage) (BzR) - preemptive or reactive CC removal.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_nature_reincarnation.gif)Taunt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=355/taunt) \- draws aggro and generally gets you killed.


## Arms Warrior Hero Talents

### Colossus Talents

**Key Talent**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_ability_colossuswarrior_demolish.gif)Demolish](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=436358/demolish) (Demo) - very powerful three-hit combo, slowing movement speed by 99%. Defensive and mobility abilities do not interrupt the attack.


**Capstone Talent**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_titansgrip.gif)Dominance of the Colossus](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=429636/dominance-of-the-colossus) \- Grants cooldown reduction and applies a debuff that increases all damage dealt, including that of the Demolish that applies it.


**Choice Nodes**

- Choice Node 1:

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_deathknight_brittlebones.gif)Boneshaker](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=429639/boneshaker) \- more of a PvP talent than a PvE one, as larger slows are easy to come by.

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shaman_earthquake.gif)Earthquaker](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=440992/earthquaker) \- very useful for its reduced cooldown, while the knock-up allows disruption in spite of diminishing returns.


- Choice Node 2:

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_incite.gif)One Against Many](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=429637/one-against-many) \- very powerful multitarget damage bonus, greatly contributing to the value of Cleave.

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_butcher_gushingwounds.gif)Arterial Bleed](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=440995/arterial-bleed) \- variable, though passive damage increase, better used against single targets.


- Choice Node 3:

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_renewedvigor.gif)No Stranger to Pain](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=429644/no-stranger-to-pain) \- increases the value of Ignore Pain, though the ability itself is rather small.

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_hunter_harass.gif)Veteran Vitality](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=440993/veteran-vitality) \- small automatic emergency heal, though it combines well with other effects.


**Passives**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_stalwartprotector.gif)Martial Expert](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=429638/martial-expert) \- one of several critical strike damage boosts.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_strengthofarms.gif)Colossal Might](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=429634/colossal-might) \- effectively doubles the damage of Demolish.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_weaponmastery.gif)Tide of Battle](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=429641/tide-of-battle) \- variable Overpower damage increase.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_warrior_sharpenblade.gif)Practiced Strikes](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=429647/practiced-strikes) \- general damage increase.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_hunter_focusingshot.gif)Precise Might](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=431548/precise-might) \- further emphasizes using Mortal Strike regularly and getting critical strikes.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_intensifyrage.gif)Mountain of Muscle and Scars](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=429642/mountain-of-muscle-and-scars) \- general damage/defense, and almost unnoticeable size increase.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_10_blacksmithing_craftedbar_bloodyalloy.gif)Decimator](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1270704/decimator) \- applies Deep Wounds in an AoE.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_deepcuts.gif)Cut to the Bone](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1270709/cut-to-the-bone) \- commonly increases bleed damage with high uptime.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_1115_warrior_fasterreflexes.gif)Celeritous Conclusion](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1270710/celeritous-conclusion) \- haste buff after Demolish.


### Slayer Talents

**Key Talent**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_ability_slayerwarrior_slayersdominance.gif)Slayer's Dominance](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=444767/slayers-dominance) \- frequent random single target damage proc that inflicts the much more important [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_lambstotheslaughter.gif)Executioner](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=445584/executioner).


**Capstone Talent**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_commandingshout.gif)Unrelenting Onslaught](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=444780/unrelenting-onslaught) \- Typically desyncs Bladestorm from other major cooldowns, though the increased frequency is worth the tradeoff.


**Choice Nodes**

- Choice Node 1:
