- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_axe_2h_orcwarrior_c_01.gif)Massacre](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=281001/massacre) \- allows more frequent use of Execute.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_skyreach_fourblades.gif)Storm of Swords](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=385512/storm-of-swords) \- largely unnecessary, resulting in overcapping.


**Row 8**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_misc_book_07.gif)Deft Experience](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=389308/deft-experience) \- a minor Mastery increase, with the much more important effect of doubling the chance to trigger Tactician.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_holy_summonchampion.gif)Valor in Victory](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=383338/valor-in-victory) \- a minor Versatility increase, which also reduces the cooldown of Die by the Sword.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_criticalstrike.gif)Critical Thinking](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=389306/critical-thinking) \- a minor Critical Strike increase, with a very impactful rage refund for Execute, which is also additive with Improved Execute for a combined 30% refund.


**Row 9**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_pvp_hardiness.gif)Battlelord](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=386630/battlelord) \- creates an entertaining gameplay loop of Mortal Strike refreshing Overpower via Tactician and Overpower refreshing Mortal Strike via Battlelord.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_skeer_bloodletting.gif)Bloodletting](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=383154/bloodletting) \- a very important bleed damage increase, which reduces the amount of maintenance required to maintain the debuffs and synergizes very well with Skullsplitter and Thunderous Roar/Words.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_bladestorm.gif)Bladestorm](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=227847/bladestorm) (BS) - Arms major multitarget cooldown, with several very powerful follow-on talents.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_ravager.gif)Ravager](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=228920/ravager) (Rav) - a passive alternative to Bladestorm, more suited for use against individual targets.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_sword_27.gif)Sharpened Blades](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=383341/sharpened-blades) \- a moderate damage increase for Arms' most important rotational abilities.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_skirmisher.gif)Juggernaut](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=383292/juggernaut) \- provides a large ramping damage increase, though not well suited for short encounters and susceptible to dropping during downtime.


**Row 10**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/achievement_bg_killingblow_berserker.gif)Fatality](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=383703/fatality) \- provides increased damage during Execute, while keeping the abilities used before Execute relevant. It cannot critically strike and does not benefit from class buffs such as Colossus Smash or Avatar, but it can be buffed by primary stat increases like Test of Might or potions.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_butcher_whirl.gif)Dance of Death](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=390713/dance-of-death) \- provides a significant damage increase for Bladestorm and can be chained from pack to pack, but the timing does not work cleanly with all of Bladestorm's other follow-on talents.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_spectralsight.gif)Unhinged](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=386628/unhinged) \- a significant single/two target damage increase while using Bladestorm or Ravager, highly effective in combination with other effects that synergize with Mortal Strike.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_ironmaidens_whirlofblood.gif)Merciless Bonegrinder](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=383317/merciless-bonegrinder) \- a major damage increase for Cleave or Whirlwind, creating strong AoE damage windows.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_revendreth_warrior.gif)Executioner's Precision](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=386634/executioners-precision) (EP) - provides great value to Mortal Strike, keeping the ability relevant during Execute.

# Arms Warrior Stat Priority - Midnight

[By Archimtiros](https://www.wowhead.com/author/Archimtiros)
Updated:
2026/02/25

Stats are a key component of customizing your Arms Warrior in Midnight. Having the right distribution of stats on your gear can be critical towards optimizing your performance.

This guide details the best stat priority for your Arms Warrior, as well as covering how to determine Arms Warrior stat priorities personalized for your character in **Midnight Season 1**, as well as how to check whether an item Best-in-Slot, an upgrade, or outright bad.

It also covers Arms Warrior's preferred stats in-depth, accounting for nuances and synergies for niche situations that go beyond a generic priority.

## ~~~~ Best Stats for Arms Warrior

Both Colossus and Slayer Arms Warrior stat priorities emphasize weapon damage and Strength (via item level), along with Critical Strike and Haste. Secondary stats can vary greatly depending on the player's level of gear, however, as the value of heavily stacked stats tends to drop as you gear beyond the point of [diminishing returns](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/diminishing-returns-on-secondary-stats-in-world-of-warcraft).

Critical Strike and Haste also have a complicated relationship - both increase rage generation, but Haste also increases the rate at which that rage can be spent by speeding up the GCD, thereby allowing more abilities to fit into de/buff windows such as Colossus Smash. While the two can frequently flip position, players will generally just want both.

**Colossus Stat Priority**

1. Strength

2. Critical Strike

3. Haste

4. Mastery

5. Versatility


**Slayer Stat Priority**

1. Strength

2. Critical Strike

3. Haste

4. Mastery

5. Versatility


**Keep in mind that these values fluctuate and the best gear actually available to you may cause you to optimize differently.**

Choosing between different pieces of gear provides an opportunity to customize stats. Following the suggestions below, we've tailored recommendations of best-in-slot gear to pursue during **Midnight Season 1** for Arms Warriors in our Gearing Guide.

[![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/inv_chest_chain_03.jpg)Arms Warrior Gearing Guide](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/arms/bis-gear)

## ~~~~ Stats Explained

**Strength** is a Warrior's primary stat, increasing all damage done by native class spells, abilities, and auto attacks. Previously one of the weakest stats, but now much more impactful, making raw item level very important.

- **Critical Strike**: Increases auto-attack rage generation, as well as damage done by abilities, auto attacks, and trinkets. It is the most important stat for reducing downtime in the rotation.

- **Haste**: Compresses the rotation by reducing the GCD and the cooldown of the rotational abilities Mortal Strike, Skullsplitter, and Cleave. The stats value frequently fluctuates with that of Critical Strike.

- **Mastery**: Increases all damage done by Warrior abilities and attacks, though it does not affect outside sources of damage such as trinkets, potions, or enchantments.

- **Versatility**: Increases damage and reduces damage taken by half. Unlike Mastery, however, it affects all damage done including trinkets, potions, and enchantments.


## ~~~~ Sim Your Arms Warrior

The suggestions for stat priorities mentioned above are generic; exact values will change based on your gear. To gain a proper understanding of your optimal stats, we recommend **simming your character** using various tools available in the community, such as [SimulationCraft](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/how-to-use-simulationcraft-and-pawn-4885). You can easily sim your character and identify your stat priority with Raidbots, an online platform! Explore more about Raidbots in our [comprehensive guide](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/how-to-use-raidbots-and-run-character-simulations-6050).

## ~~~~ Diminishing Returns in Midnight

Accumulating too much of one Secondary stat from your gear leads to diminishing returns. This means that adding more of the same stat beyond certain thresholds results in reduced benefits. These thresholds are fixed and reduce the amount gained from more of that stat rating by 10% per breakpoint. Each stat has a different rating threshold where the reduction begins:

- **Critical Strike** \- Above 1380 rating

- **Haste** \- Above 1320 rating

- **Mastery** \- Above 1380 rating

- **Versatility** \- Above 1620 rating


**Example**

Let's assume you gain 1% Haste for 10 Haste Rating. When above the diminishing return breakpoint, 10 Haste Rating would give you 0.9% Haste instead, resulting in a 10% reduction from what you gained previously.

Note that this system **only counts stat rating**, meaning that percentage-based procs and effects like [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_nature_bloodlust.gif)Bloodlust](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=2825/bloodlust) aren't factored in and will always grant their full benefit.

You can learn more about stat diminishing returns in our detailed guide:

[What are Stat Diminishing Returns](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/diminishing-returns-on-secondary-stats-in-world-of-warcraft)

# Arms Warrior Rotation Guide - Midnight

[By Archimtiros](https://www.wowhead.com/author/Archimtiros)
Updated:
2026/03/05

Welcome to the Arms Warrior rotation guide for Midnight Season 1! This guide will teach you all about the optimal rotation for Arms Warrior across its various talent builds. It will cover both core ability cadence and cooldown usage in dungeons and raids for **Midnight Season 1**.

## Arms Warrior Rotation in Midnight Season 1

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| |     |     |
| --- | --- |
| Arms Warriors revolve around using abilities to increase the damage of their attacks, inflict bleeds, and maximize Execute damage. Although the standard rotation is not very complex, there are several synergistic talents that create more complex priorities.

* * *

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| ~~~~ | **Avoid Downtime** \- Arms generates the majority of its rage from auto-attacks, so reducing the amount of time spent chasing, running out mechanics, or otherwise not hitting the boss is critical to maximizing performance. There are several abilities to help with this, such as [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_charge.gif)Charge](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=100/charge) and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_heroicleap.gif)Heroic Leap](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=6544/heroic-leap), so use them smartly to stay on target as much as possible! |

* * *

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| ~~~~ | **Keep Abilities on cooldown** \- Arms generates and spends resources in small amounts, but its ability cooldowns are what really drive the rotation. Keeping Colossus Smash, Avatar, and Bladestorm/Demolish on cooldown is crucial, as delaying any one of them can easily cause the others to desync as well, so avoid doing it without good reason - such as a quickly approaching add or increased damage phase. |

* * *

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| ~~~~ | **Avoid wasting Rage** \- Unlike most resources, Rage starts from zero and decays out of combat. Making efficient use of it will help maintain the rotation and eliminate downtime spent waiting for more resources, both in combat and by reducing the amount of time spent moving from one combat to another. | | |

* * *

**Reading Priority Lists**

Abilities and talents are listed from highest to lowest priority in the Arms Warrior rotation. Every time an ability is cast, begin again at the top of the list and move down until there is something that can be cast, then return to the top once more.

[![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/classicon_warrior.jpg)Arms Warrior Starter Guide](https://www.wowhead.com/guide=33100)

## ~~~~ Best Arms Warrior Rotation

For all forms of content, Arms follows a priority list of what spells to cast. Below, we break down the main priority lists for Arms Warriors: Single-Target Rotation, AoE Rotation, and various openers.

- **New in Patch 12.0.1**: Sudden Death now triggers Reap the Storm, giving Execute a very high priority in multitarget.

## ~~~~ Best Arms Warrior Opener

Aside from always opening with [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_charge.gif)Charge](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=100/charge) for a small boost to rage generation, the Arms opener is virtually identical to its single-target priority.

Unless there are upcoming adds or an increased damage phase, [stat increasing trinkets](https://www.wowhead.com/item=133300) are best used on the pull, while [combat potions](https://www.wowhead.com/item=212265) are better saved for Execute unless two potions will be available during the encounter.

## Pre-Combat Check

Before any form of combat, whether raids, dungeons, delves, or even open-world content, ensure that [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_battleshout.gif)Battle Shout](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=6673/battle-shout) is active on yourself and all relevant party members. In higher-end content, applying a food buff, flask, weapon oils, and preparing a combat potion is also a good idea.

## ~~~~ Arms Warriors Major Cooldowns

Colossus Smash

Avatar

Bladestorm

Champion's Spear

Arms' primary cooldown should be used liberally whether facing single or multiple targets. Its cooldown is reduced by [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_angermanagement.gif)Anger Management](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=152278/anger-management), which keeps it aligned with Avatar, but can also be reduced further by [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv12_apextalent_warrior_masterofwarfare.gif)Master of Warfare](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1269307/master-of-warfare), causing the two to misalign.

A secondary cooldown, it now provides only a basic damage bonus, which should be used with Colossus Smash as much as possible, but is otherwise uneventful.

A secondary cooldown used exclusively by Slayer, it deals a good amount of single and multitarget damage, while also triggering supplementary effects such as [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_butcher_exsanguination.gif)Violent Euphoria](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1270717/violent-euphoria) and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_spectralsight.gif)Unhinged](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=386628/unhinged). It has a unique form of cooldown reduction, so it will not always align with other cooldowns, making it important to think about when to use the cooldown and when to save it.

A talented attack in the class tree, which serves more of a utility role in keeping enemies within an area, though its damage is rather mediocre. The ability can be reactivated to leap to the spear, though this has very niche applications.

## ~~~~ Arms Warrior Advanced Tips

Maximizing Uptime

Aligning Cooldowns

Arms Warriors are very straightforward damage dealers, with a very flat damage profile not concentrated entirely into cooldown windows. Because of this, the biggest optimization is simply maximizing uptime on the target - knowing what mechanics are coming _before_ they actually happen will help plan movement to minimize time spent off target, allowing more rage to be generated and more GCDs to be fit into the overall rotation.

There are a variety of tools to help with this, from using [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_heroicleap.gif)Heroic Leap](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=6544/heroic-leap) to move out of range at the last moment before damage goes out, to using [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_charge.gif)Charge](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=100/charge) after a target has finished moving, which are largely a byproduct of time and experience.

Arms Warriors have several cooldowns, but they're all used more or less the same way - on cooldown as much as possible. When situations or timers allow, cooldowns can be aligned, but they should not be delayed by a significant amount (typically no less than 10-15% of their actual cooldown) unless the delay will allow them to hit multiple targets when they would otherwise hit one, or it will be your final use of the cooldown before the end of the fight regardless.

The reason is that losing an entire use of a cooldown is typically a bigger loss than what is gained by stacking the cooldown with something else to amplify it. Some cooldowns will always align naturally, though others will not, so anticipating those timers and knowing when adds or important damage phases are coming is key.

### Arms Warrior Flasks

The best flask for Arms Warriors is [![Flask of the Shattered Sun](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_alchemy_flask_sindoreipotion_red--.gif)Flask of the Shattered Sun![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241326/flask-of-the-shattered-sun) or [![Flask of the Blood Knights](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_alchemy_flask_sindoreipotion_white-.gif)Flask of the Blood Knights![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241324/flask-of-the-blood-knights).

[![Potion of Recklessness](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_alchemy_voidpotion_red.gif)Potion of Recklessness![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241288/potion-of-recklessness) is the best combat potion in all content for Arms Warriors, though [![Light's Potential](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_alchemy_lightpotion_yellow.gif)Light's Potential![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241308/lights-potential) is a very close alternative. [![Draught of Rampant Abandon](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_alchemy_voidpotion_purple.gif)Draught of Rampant Abandon![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241292/draught-of-rampant-abandon) can be powerful, but the frequent need to move to avoid being silenced makes it less useful in practice.

[![Silvermoon Health Potion](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_alchemy_lightpotion_orange.gif)Silvermoon Health Potion![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241304/silvermoon-health-potion) is the best healing potion in The War Within.

### Arms Warrior Weapon Buff

Arms Warriors should apply [![Thalassian Phoenix Oil](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_enchanting_manaoil_red.gif)Thalassian Phoenix Oil![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=243734/thalassian-phoenix-oil) to their weapon.

[![Void-Touched Augment Rune](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_10_enchanting_crystal_color2.gif)Void-Touched Augment Rune](https://www.wowhead.com/item=259085/void-touched-augment-rune) is the only new Augment Rune in The War Within.

[![Blooming Feast](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_misc_food_cooked_greatpabanquet_wok.gif)Blooming Feast](https://www.wowhead.com/item=242273/blooming-feast), [![Champion's Bento](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_misc_food_vendor_poundedricecake_1.gif)Champion's Bento](https://www.wowhead.com/item=242274/champions-bento), and [![Flora Frenzy](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_cooking_100_sidesalad_color04.gif)Flora Frenzy](https://www.wowhead.com/item=255848/flora-frenzy) all provide the maximum benefit.

[Changelog](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/changelog?id=3087) # Fury Warrior DPS Guide - Midnight [By Archimtiros](https://www.wowhead.com/author/Archimtiros) Updated: 2026/02/25 Welcome to Wowhead's **Midnight Season 1** Fury Warrior guide. This guide will help you master your Fury Warrior in most forms of PvE content in the game, including raids and dungeons. [Overview](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/fury/overview-pve-dps) [BiS Gear](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/fury/bis-gear) [Rotation](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/fury/rotation-cooldowns-pve-dps) [Talent Builds](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/fury/talent-builds-pve-dps) [Consumables](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/fury/enchants-gems-pve-dps) [Stats](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/fury/stat-priority-pve-dps) [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/large/inv_misc_groupneedmore.jpg)\\ Basics](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/fury/basics) Show Table of Contents ## ~~~~ Fury Warrior Overview Fury is a spec with a fast-paced playstyle that focuses on sustained damage, rather than spikes of big bursts. With only one [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_misc_emotionangry.gif)Rage](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=100415/rage) spending ability, the goal of the rotation is simple: Generate enough Rage to cast [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_rampage.gif)Rampage](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=184367/rampage) and maintain [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_unholyfrenzy.gif)Enrage](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=184361/enrage), along with a multitude of different abilities that will also be used along the way. Fury Warrior is a good spec for players looking for a playstyle that is always active, since every other ability is a resource generator that has a short or no cooldown, without any downtime spent waiting for something to do. This makes it highly engaging and proves that a specialization doesn't need to be complicated in order to be fun. ## ~~~~ Fury Warrior Strengths and Weaknesses | | | | | --- | --- | --- | | **Strengths** | | **Weaknesses** | | - Excels at dynamically swapping between single-target and multi-target.

- Bursty multi-target cooldowns.

- Strong burst mobility and gap closers.

- Good personal defensive abilities and a raid-wide defensive cooldown. | | - Very susceptible to downtime due to the lack of ranged attacks or passive resource generation.

- Flat damage profile is less suited toward burst phases or very short encounters.

- Minimum range restrictions and cooldowns can limit mobility in bad situations.

- Gimmicky cheat death is not viable in most PvE content. | ## ~~~~ Fury Warrior Cheat Sheet ![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/logos/wh-logo-thumbnail.png)WowheadFury Warrior Raid Warrior Changes in Midnight Fury Warriors have undergone several major talent changes in Midnight, including the removal of some active abilities. ### Removed Abilities - **[Onslaught](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=315720)** - **[Ravager](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=228920)** - **[Bitter Immunity](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=383762)** - **[Thunderous Roar](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=384318)** ### New Abilities - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_gouge.gif)Rend](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=772/rend) ## Fury Warrior Hero Talents: Mountain Thane and Slayer Fury Warriors have the choice between the Mountain Thane and Slayer Hero Talents, with each introducing their own gameplay elements. - Mountain Thane harnesses the power of the storm, calling down [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_vehicle_electrocharge.gif)Lightning Strikes](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=434969/lightning-strikes) and reintroducing [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_nature_thunderclap.gif)Thunder Clap](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=6343/thunder-clap) to Fury Warriors for the first time since Vanilla. [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_nature_thunderclap.gif)Crashing Thunder](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=436707/crashing-thunder) turns it into a hard-hitting Rage generator that takes the place of Whirlwind in the rotation while still benefiting from all the same talents and effects. Combined with [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/shaman_pvp_thundercharge.gif)Burst of Power](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=437118/burst-of-power) and the potential to turn Thunder Clap into the even stronger [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_bloodandthunder.gif)Thunder Blast](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=435607/thunder-blast), Mountain Thane is as chaotic as its storm-inspired abilities. - By contrast, Slayer greatly enhances the capability of [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_sword_48.gif)Execute](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=5308/execute) and the newly re-added [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_bladestorm.gif)Bladestorm](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=227847/bladestorm), causing both to be used very frequently and deal significantly increased damage. Although Slayer lacks compelling defensive benefits, it does feature mobility enhancements to [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_charge.gif)Charge](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=100/charge) and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_heroicleap.gif)Heroic Leap](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=6544/heroic-leap), alongside the long-desired ability to interrupt and stun while channeling Bladestorm. [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/ability_marksmanship.jpg)Talent Builds](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/fury/talent-builds-pve-dps) ## ~~~~ Playing a Fury Warrior in Midnight Season 1 Fury Warriors revolve around maximizing [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_unholyfrenzy.gif)Enrage](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=184361/enrage) uptime and dealing damage through fast-paced attacks and a variety of special abilities, excelling at dealing high multi-target damage while sacrificing little to no single-target performance to do so. | | | | --- | --- | | | | | | --- | --- | | ~~~~ | **Avoid Downtime**: Fury generates the majority of its [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_misc_emotionangry.gif)Rage](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=100415/rage) from abilities, so reducing the amount of time spent chasing targets, running out mechanics, or otherwise not attacking foes is critical towards maximizing performance. There are several abilities to help with this, such as [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_charge.gif)Charge](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=100/charge) and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_heroicleap.gif)Heroic Leap](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=6544/heroic-leap), so use them smartly to stay on target as much as possible! | * * * | | | | --- | --- | | ~~~~ | **Keep Abilities on cooldown**: Nearly every rotational Fury ability generates Rage, though only one spends it, and in large amounts. This makes maximizing Rage income very important to ensure that the rotation never starves so much that it drops Enrage. | * * * | | | | --- | --- | | ~~~~ | **Avoid wasting Rage**: Unlike most resources, [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_misc_emotionangry.gif)Rage](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=100415/rage) starts from zero and decays out of combat. Making efficient use of it, both in combat and by reducing the amount of time spent moving from one combat encounter to the next, will help maintain the rotation and eliminate downtime spent waiting for more resources. | | [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/spell_mekkatorque_bot_bluegear.jpg)Rotation](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/fury/rotation-cooldowns-pve-dps) [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/inv_112_achievement_raid_manaforgeomega.jpg)Raid Tips](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/fury/manaforge-omega-raid-tips) [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/inv_relics_hourglass.jpg)Mythic+](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/fury/mythic-plus-dungeon-tips) ## ~~~~ Gearing a Fury Warrior in Midnight Season 1 As a general guideline, follow the stat priority of: **Haste > Mastery > Critical Strike ~= Versatility**. Don't neglect the value of **Strength**, as a substantial increase in item level is typically going to be worth it compared to optimized stats. It is always recommended that you use [Raidbots](https://www.raidbots.com/simbot/stats) to sim your own character, since every character is different. [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/inv_chest_chain_03.jpg)Best-in-Slot Gear](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/fury/bis-gear) ## ~~~~ What Professions are Best for Fury Warrior? Compared to previous expansions, professions in Midnight provide minimal benefits towards the performance of your spec. This means that Fury Warrior players can choose any profession according to personal preference. You might consider [Blacksmithing](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/midnight/professions/blacksmithing-overview-trainer-locations-recipes-tools) to craft your own armor, as many profession items can be very close to your [Best in Slot gear](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/fury/bis-gear). On the other hand, you may opt for [Alchemy](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/midnight/professions/alchemy-overview-trainer-locations-recipes-tools) to craft consumables or [Enchanting](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/midnight/professions/enchanting-overview-trainer-locations-recipes-tools) to enchant gear without relying on the Auction House. [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/inv_inscription_80_warscroll_intellect.jpg)Stats](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/fury/stat-priority-pve-dps) [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/ui_concentration.jpg)Professions in Midnight](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/professions/overview) ## ~~~~ What Race is Best for Fury Warrior? Any race can be a Warrior, allowing the greatest number of options, each with its own strengths and special abilities! Unless you desire a specific effect, it's generally recommended to pick a race based on aesthetic preferences, since the performative difference between them tends to be extremely small. ## ~~~~ Rotation Priority for Fury Warrior Beginners

This is a simple example of the spell priorities that make up the basic Fury Warrior rotation. More information about the rotation, as well as an explanation of important abilities and advanced tips can be found in the [Fury Warrior Rotation Guide](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/fury/rotation-cooldowns-pve-dps).

Use major cooldowns whenever burst damage is needed, use [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_rampage.gif)Rampage](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=184367/rampage) whenever available, and fill the rest of the rotation with [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_nature_bloodlust.gif)Bloodthirst](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=23881/bloodthirst), [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_nature_thunderclap.gif)Thunder Clap](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=6343/thunder-clap), [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_sword_48.gif)Execute](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=5308/execute), or [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_wild_strike.gif)Raging Blow](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=85288/raging-blow).

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| |     |     |
| --- | --- |
| ~~~~ | **Avoid Downtime** \- Fury generates the majority of its rage from abilities, so reducing the amount of time spent chasing, running out mechanics, or otherwise not hitting the boss is critical to maximizing performance. There are several abilities to help with this, such as [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_charge.gif)Charge](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=100/charge) and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_heroicleap.gif)Heroic Leap](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=6544/heroic-leap), so use them smartly to stay on target as much as possible! |

* * *

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| ~~~~ | **Keep Abilities on cooldown** \- nearly every rotational Fury ability generates rage, though only Rampage spends it, and in large amounts. This makes it very important to ensure that abilities are constantly being used to ensure that it drops Enrage. |

* * *

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| ~~~~ | **Avoid wasting Rage** \- unlike most resources, rage starts from zero and decays out of combat. Making efficient use of it, both in combat and by reducing the amount of time spent moving from one combat to another, will help maintain the rotation and eliminate downtime spent waiting for more resources. | |

## ~~~~ Best Stats for Fury Warrior Beginners

Strength is a Warrior's primary stat, increasing the damage of abilities and found on all gear. Haste increases the pace of gameplay, while Mastery, Critical Strike, and Versatility are more passive damage increases.

For more details, check our [Fury Warrior Stats guide](https://www.wowhead.com/guide=5530).

# Fury Warrior Abilities and Talents Guide - Midnight

[By Archimtiros](https://www.wowhead.com/author/Archimtiros)

2026/02/25

Explore the depths of the Fury Warrior talent tree, which contains the bulk of your abilities and customization options. In this Fury Warrior guide, we review all the different abilities and talents in **Midnight Season 1**, including an explanation for what they do and how to use them correctly.

## ~~~~ Baseline Fury Warrior Abilities

### Offensive Abilities

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_whirlwind.gif)Whirlwind](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=190411/whirlwind) (WW) - primary multitarget attack which facilitates cleaving other attacks.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_decisivestrike.gif)Slam](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1464/slam) \- initial rage spender, quickly replaced by other abilities.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_shield_05.gif)Shield Slam](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=23922/shield-slam) \- early offensive ability, replaced upon specializing.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_shockwave.gif)Hamstring](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1715/hamstring) \- minor snare.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_devastate.gif)Victory Rush](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=34428/victory-rush) (VR) - very useful free heal after getting a kill.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_sword_48.gif)Execute](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=5308/execute) (Exe) - Fury's version of Execute

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_axe_66.gif)Heroic Throw](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=57755/heroic-throw) (HT) - pitifully low damage ranged attack, only appropriate for pulling from a distance.


### Utility Abilities

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_charge.gif)Charge](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=100/charge) \- primary mobility and gap closer.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_gauntlets_04.gif)Pummel](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=6552/pummel) \- low cooldown interrupt.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_battleshout.gif)Battle Shout](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=6673/battle-shout) (Shout) - worth ~5% damage for melee classes and Hunters.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_nature_ancestralguardian.gif)Berserker Rage](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=18499/berserker-rage) (BzR) - preemptive or reactive CC removal.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_nature_reincarnation.gif)Taunt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=355/taunt) \- draws aggro and generally gets you killed.


## Fury Warrior Hero Talents

### Mountain Thane Talents

**Key Talent**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_vehicle_electrocharge.gif)Lightning Strikes](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=434969/lightning-strikes) \- random single target damage proc from most rotational abilities. The increased chance is multiplicative (25 \* 1.3 = 32.5% chance), rather than additive.


**Capstone Talent**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/achievement_dungeon_blackrockcaverns_ascendantlordobsidius.gif)Avatar of the Storm](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=437134/avatar-of-the-storm) \- Thunder Blast charges are only granted by natural casts of Avatar, not including procs from Berserker or Titan's Torment.


**Choice Nodes**

- Choice Node 1:

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_stormbolt.gif)Storm Bolts](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=436162/storm-bolts) \- a mostly PvP talent, as being unable to dictate which two extra targets can contribute to diminishing returns.

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_winston_bubble.gif)Storm Shield](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=438597/storm-shield) \- has very low value for Fury Warriors, due to their lower armor values.


- Choice Node 2:

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_thunderking_overcharge.gif)Keep Your Feet on the Ground](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=438590/keep-your-feet-on-the-ground) \- very strong passive defensive bonus due to the high frequency of Thunder Blast procs.

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_devastate.gif)Steadfast as the Peaks](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=434970/steadfast-as-the-peaks) \- less powerful, but on-demand; pre-emptive use of Impending Victory allows for significantly increased health pools to

    help survive predictable spikes of damage.


- Choice Node 3:

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_lightning_lightningbolt01.gif)Flashing Skies](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=437079/flashing-skies) \- significantly boosts the single target value of Thunder Blast. Triggers in addition to the normal random chance for a lightning strike, allowing two for one cast.

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_thunderking_thunderstruck.gif)Snap Induction](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=456270/snap-induction) \- has minor value with Anger Management, but otherwise overlaps with casts of Avatar, which already grants two charges of Thunder Blast.


- Choice Node 4:

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_nature_stormreach.gif)Gathering Clouds](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=436201/gathering-clouds) \- the increased chance is multiplicative (25 \* 1.3 = 32.5% chance), rather than additive.

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_ability_mountainthanewarrior_thorimsmight.gif)Thorim's Might](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=436152/thorims-might) \- very powerful, giving lightning strikes and rotational abilities much more value.


**Passives**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_nature_thunderclap.gif)Crashing Thunder](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=436707/crashing-thunder) \- allows Thunder Clap to effectively replace Whirlwind within the rotation.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_thunderstruck.gif)Ground Current](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=436148/ground-current) \- allows Lightning Strikes to hit multiple targets for significantly reduced damage. Does not hit the primary target of the lightning strike's initial target.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_titansgrip.gif)Strength of the Mountain](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=437068/strength-of-the-mountain) \- general damage increase.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_bloodandthunder.gif)Thunder Blast](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=435607/thunder-blast) \- enables Thunder Blast, a stronger version of Thunder Clap that ignores armor.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/shaman_pvp_thundercharge.gif)Burst of Power](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=437118/burst-of-power) \- makes Bloodthirst better.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_racial_avatar.gif)Storm Surge](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=275336/storm-surge) \- allows Thunder Clap and Blast to be used more reactively and regularly.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shaman_thunderstorm.gif)Conductivity](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1270723/conductivity) \- passive single target damage increase.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_nature_purge.gif)Capacitance](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1270724/capacitance) \- extends Avatar.


### Slayer Talents

**Key Talent**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_ability_slayerwarrior_slayersdominance.gif)Slayer's Dominance](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=444767/slayers-dominance) \- frequent random single target damage proc that inflicts the much more important [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_lambstotheslaughter.gif)Executioner](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=445584/executioner).


**Capstone Talent**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_commandingshout.gif)Unrelenting Onslaught](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=444780/unrelenting-onslaught) \- Typically desyncs Bladestorm from other major cooldowns, though the increased frequency is worth the tradeoff.


**Choice Nodes**

- Choice Node 1:

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_rogue_sprint.gif)Relentless Pursuit](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=444776/relentless-pursuit) \- very useful for keeping up with moving targets, especially when charging on the pull.

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_paladin_speedoflight.gif)Vicious Agility](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=444777/vicious-agility) \- less regularly useful outside of specific encounter timing, though minorly better for open world content.


- Choice Node 2:

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_bladestorm.gif)Culling Cyclone](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=444778/culling-cyclone) \- increases the single target value of Bladestorm, but does not further increase damage by hitting multiple targets.

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_revendreth_warrior.gif)Brutal Finish](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=446085/brutal-finish) \- better against multiple targets due to the damage bonus applying to each target hit.


- Choice Node 3:

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_deathknight_butcher2.gif)Fierce Followthrough](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=444773/fierce-followthrough) \- only triggers off crits against the primary target, though the resulting damage bonus affects every target.

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_weaponmastery.gif)Opportunist](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=444774/opportunist) \- low value due to relying on Raging Blow resetting itself, rather than resets from Hack & Slash.


**Passives**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_improveddisciplines.gif)Imminent Demise](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=444769/imminent-demise) \- more Sudden Death procs and makes Bladestorm much more powerful, has strong synergy with [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_spectralsight.gif)Unhinged](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=386628/unhinged).

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_10_specialization_blacksmithing_blades_color1.gif)Overwhelming Blades](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=444772/overwhelming-blades) \- universal damage increase with a very high uptime.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_focusedrage.gif)Death Drive](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=444770/death-drive) \- very minor and largely random, which means it will not always be effective healing.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_lambstotheslaughter.gif)Show No Mercy](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=444771/show-no-mercy) \- another passive damage increase for Execute.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_arakkoa_spinning_blade.gif)Reap the Storm](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=444775/reap-the-storm) \- multitarget damage contributor that helps apply and maintain the Overwhelmed damage bonus.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_revenge.gif)Slayer's Malice](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=444779/slayers-malice) \- general damage increase further emphasizing Raging Blow and Execute.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_butcher_exsanguination.gif)Violent Euphoria](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1270717/violent-euphoria) \- haste buff after Bladestorm.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_hunter_focusingshot.gif)Deadly Focus](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1270718/deadly-focus) \- increases the duration of Executioner, allowing more stack overlap.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_spectralsight.gif)Unhinged](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=386628/unhinged) \- triggers automatic Bloodthirsts that can proc associated effects.


## ~~~~ Warrior Talents

### Class Talents

**Row 1**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_offensivestance.gif)Battle Stance](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=386164/battle-stance) (Battle/BStance) - basic offensive stance.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_defensivestance.gif)Defensive Stance](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=386208/defensive-stance) (Def/DStance) - basic defensive stance.


**Row 2**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_hunter_posthaste.gif)Fast Footwork](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=382260/fast-footwork) \- minor passive speed boost.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_hunter_rapidkilling.gif)War Machine](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=262231/war-machine) \- passive boost to rage generation with bonus on kill effects.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_artifact_bloodoftheassassinated.gif)Leeching Strikes](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=382258/leeching-strikes) \- minor passive healing boost.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_victoryrush.gif)Intervene](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=3411/intervene) \- charge an ally!


**Row 3**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_impending_victory.gif)Impending Victory](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=202168/impending-victory) (IV) - on-demand version of Victory Rush.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_heroicleap.gif)Heroic Leap](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=6544/heroic-leap) (Leap) - burst mobility skill, which does not immune ground effects like Blink, but can be useful for avoiding knockbacks.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_stormbolt.gif)Storm Bolt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=107570/storm-bolt) \- useful ranged stun on a relatively low cooldown.


**Row 4**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_golemthunderclap.gif)Intimidating Shout](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=5246/intimidating-shout) \- easily broken AoE fear which can be used as a pseudo interrupt.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_hunter_harass.gif)Second Wind](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=29838/second-wind) \- very rarely ignores environmental damage, but is usually broken by most effects.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_furyintheblood.gif)Frothing Berserker](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=392792/frothing-berserker) \- inconsistent passive rage refund.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_heroicleap.gif)Bounding Stride](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=202163/bounding-stride) \- allows more leaping.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_holy_painsupression.gif)Pain and Gain](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=382549/pain-and-gain) \- passive self-healing.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_nature_thunderclap.gif)Thunder Clap](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=6343/thunder-clap) (TC) - a core part of Mountain Thane, but otherwise unused.


**Row 5**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_fomor_boss_shout.gif)Cacophonous Roar](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=382954/cacophonous-roar) \- still broken far too easily in group content, only moderately viable in PvP.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_golemthunderclap.gif)Menace](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=275338/menace) \- still easily broken in PvE, though moderately more useful due to the knockback.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_shieldreflection.gif)Spell Reflection](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=23920/spell-reflection) (SR) - very useful, low cooldown damage reduction.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_rallyingcry.gif)Rallying Cry](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=97462/rallying-cry) (Rally) - one of the few raid-wide defensive abilities.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_shockwave.gif)Shockwave](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=46968/shockwave) \- on demand AoE stun.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_garrosh_whirling_corruption.gif)Barbaric Training](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=383082/barbaric-training) \- only useful for Mountain Thane in multitarget.


**Row 6**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_holy_borrowedtime.gif)Honed Reflexes](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=391271/honed-reflexes) \- Reduces most defensive cooldowns by a very minor amount.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_unholystrength.gif)Crushing Force](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=382764/crushing-force) \- major damage increase for Slam.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_nature_shamanrage.gif)Bitter Immunity](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=383762/bitter-immunity) \- highly situational due to its long cooldown.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/racial_orc_berserkerstrength.gif)Overwhelming Rage](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=382767/overwhelming-rage) \- eases the burdens of rage management.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shaman_earthquake.gif)Rumbling Earth](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=275339/rumbling-earth) \- greatly increases the usefulness of Shockwave when using it regularly against groups.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_chest_plate04.gif)Reinforced Plates](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=382939/reinforced-plates) \- synergizes with Armored to the Teeth to provide additional damage.


**Row 7**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_mastercleaver.gif)Wrecking Throw](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=384110/wrecking-throw) \- highly effective against absorption shields, though rarely a major gain.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_shatteringthrow.gif)Shattering Throw](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=64382/shattering-throw) \- immunity breaking version of Wrecking Throw, rarely used in PvE.

- [(Spell #390674)](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=390674) \- only useful for Mountain Thane.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_throwingaxe_06.gif)Sidearm](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=384404/sidearm) \- minor passive damage increase.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_misc_horn_04.gif)Double Time](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=103827/double-time) \- a must-have mobility increase.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_bloodnova.gif)Seismic Reverberation](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=382956/seismic-reverberation) \- very minor with Whirlwind, but highly effective for Mountain Thane.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_intervene.gif)Concussive Blows](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=383115/concussive-blows) \- rather underwhelming due to only affecting the target which is interrupted, rather than increasing all damage dealt, though the reduced cooldown can be nice.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_nature_ancestralguardian.gif)Berserker Shout](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=384100/berserker-shout) \- seldom used group-wide fear breaker.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_deathscream.gif)Piercing Howl](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=12323/piercing-howl) \- major AoE snare, offset by its cooldown.


**Row 8**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_criticalstrike.gif)Cruel Strikes](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=392777/cruel-strikes) \- a minor increase to Execute, smaller than it may seem.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_rogue_sprint.gif)Wild Strikes](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=382946/wild-strikes) \- deceptively powerful due to the already high frequency of auto-attacks.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_dualwield.gif)Dual Wield Specialization](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=382900/dual-wield-specialization) \- a must-have passive damage increase.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_shoulder_22.gif)Armored to the Teeth](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=384124/armored-to-the-teeth) \- near indispensable damage increase that helps gear scaling over the course of an expansion.


**Row 9**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_dragonroar.gif)Thunderous Roar](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=384318/thunderous-roar) (Roar)- stronger than it may seem, due to its bleed damage being uncapped, allowing it to fully damage any number of extra targets.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_avatar.gif)Avatar](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=107574/avatar) (Ava) - one of the main personal cooldowns that should always be taken.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_ability_warrior_championsspear.gif)Champion's Spear](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=376079/champions-spear) (Spear) - aligns well with other 90s cooldowns, though not generally as useful as Thunderous Roar.


**Row 10**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_misc_head_dragon_01.gif)Uproar](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=391572/uproar) \- keeps Thunderous Roar aligned with Avatar and other cooldowns, provides a noticeable overall damage increase, especially in multitarget.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_nature_earthquake.gif)Thunderous Words](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=384969/thunderous-words) \- increases the damage of all bleeds only while Thunderous Roar is active, creating powerful burst windows that synergize well with Odyn's Fury.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_innerrage.gif)Berserker's Torment](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=390123/berserkers-torment) \- highly effective and extends the duration of their normal counterparts.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/70_inscription_vantus_rune_odyn.gif)Titan's Torment](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=390135/titans-torment) \- very strong AoE damage increase, which synergizes with other additional effects from Odyn's Fury.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_revendreth_warrior.gif)Piercing Challenge](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=382948/piercing-challenge) \- a minor overall damage increase, though the extra rage generation is largely irrelevant.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_bastion_warrior.gif)Champion's Might](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=386284/champions-might) \- a short but powerful damage window, which now activates on the target instead of requiring the player to stand within a specific location.


### Spec Talents

**Apex**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv12_apextalent_warrior_rampagingberserker2.gif)Rampaging Berserker](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1269308/rampaging-berserker) \- passively increases strength, stacks have individual durations rather than constantly refresh

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv12_apextalent_warrior_rampagingberserker2.gif)Rampaging Berserker](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1269309/rampaging-berserker) \- reduces Rampage cost during Recklessness

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv12_apextalent_warrior_rampagingberserker2.gif)Rampaging Berserker](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1269310/rampaging-berserker) \- more stacks during Recklessness allows for more power during cooldowns


**Passive**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_titansgrip.gif)Titan's Grip](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=46917/titans-grip) (TG) - passive bonus which allows dual wielding two-handed weapons.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_endlessrage.gif)Mastery: Unshackled Fury](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=76856/mastery-unshackled-fury) \- passive bonus which scales damage with Mastery.


**Row 1**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_nature_bloodlust.gif)Bloodthirst](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=23881/bloodthirst) (BT) - Primary attack which forms the basis of the rotation.


**Row 2**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_wild_strike.gif)Raging Blow](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=85288/raging-blow) (RB) - Primary attack which forms the basis of the rotation.


**Row 3**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_unholyfrenzy.gif)Frenzied Enrage](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=383848/frenzied-enrage) \- greatly increases the speed of Fury gameplay.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_strengthofarms.gif)Powerful Enrage](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=440277/powerful-enrage) \- large damage increase without increasing the speed of Fury gameplay.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_focusedrage.gif)Enraged Regeneration](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=184364/enraged-regeneration) (ER) - Fury's primary defensive cooldown.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_sword_48.gif)Improved Execute](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=316402/improved-execute) \- turns Execute into a rage generator.


**Row 4**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_furyintheblood.gif)Spite](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=383852/spite) \- very small but worthwhile damage increase.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_deathwing_bloodcorruption_death.gif)Fresh Meat](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=215568/fresh-meat) \- useful leveling talent, but not very useful anywhere else.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_rogue_preparation.gif)Warpaint](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=208154/warpaint) \- strong passive damage reduction.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_misc_emotionangry.gif)Invigorating Fury](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=383468/invigorating-fury) \- situationally useful in PvP, but otherwise much worse than Warpaint.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_improveddisciplines.gif)Sudden Death](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=280721/sudden-death) (SD) - allows more proc based gameplay, and can now stack up to two times.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_nature_focusedmind.gif)Cruelty](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=392931/cruelty) \- notable damage increase, though only while Enraged.


**Row 5**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_hunter_mastermarksman.gif)Focus in Chaos](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=383486/focus-in-chaos) \- removes the 19% dual wield miss penalty from auto-attacks, although they can still be parried.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_rampage.gif)Rampage](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=184367/rampage) (Ramp) - the core of Fury's rotation, converting rage into damage and Enrage.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_wild_strike.gif)Improved Raging Blow](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=383854/improved-raging-blow) \- critical talent which enables Raging Blow resets.


**Row 6**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_singlemindedfury.gif)Titan's Grip: Single-Minded Fury](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=81099/titans-grip-single-minded-fury) \- increase the effectiveness of dual wielding one-handed weapons, but not by enough to make them competitive with two-handed weapons.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_rogue_hungerforblood.gif)Cold Steel, Hot Blood](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=383959/cold-steel-hot-blood) (CSHB) - inflicts a powerful bleed, which can be applied to multiple targets via Whirlwind.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_ironmaidens_sorkasprey.gif)Vicious Contempt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=383885/vicious-contempt) (VC) - promotes Bloodthirst playstyles by greatly increasing its damage during the execute phase.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_rogue_bloodyeye.gif)Frenzy](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=335077/frenzy) \- semi-passive haste buff, with the downside of easily falling off when regularly switching targets.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_rogue_rollthebones02.gif)Hack and Slash](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=383877/hack-and-slash) (HnS/H&S) - very important reset mechanic for Raging Blow builds.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_axe_2h_orcwarrior_c_01.gif)Slaughtering Strikes](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=388004/slaughtering-strikes) \- provides a significant damage boost for Rampage and greatly emphasizes Raging Blow's role in the rotation.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_skirmisher.gif)Ashen Juggernaut](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=392536/ashen-juggernaut) \- provides a significant damage boost when using Execute regularly.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_whirlwind.gif)Improved Whirlwind](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=12950/improved-whirlwind) \- enables Fury's ability to cleave single target attacks onto other targets, forming the basis of its multitarget rotation.


**Row 7**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_artifact_bloodoftheassassinated.gif)Bloodborne](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=385703/bloodborne) \- a large boost to bleed damage for builds that invest in it.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_creature_cursed_02.gif)Bloodcraze](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=393950/bloodcraze) \- creates strong synergy between Raging Blow and Bloodthirst, though it resets after any critical strike from Bloodthirst.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_innerrage.gif)Recklessness](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1719/recklessness) (Reck) - Fury's primary offensive cooldown, greatly increasing rage generation and the frequency of Rampage casts.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_axe_2h_orcwarrior_c_01.gif)Massacre](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=206315/massacre) \- allows more frequent use of Execute.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_sword_2h_artifactarathor_d_03.gif)Wrath and Fury](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=392936/wrath-and-fury) \- a moderate damage and reset chance increase for Raging Blow.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_mastercleaver.gif)Meat Cleaver](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=280392/meat-cleaver) \- reduces the amount of Whirlwind casts needed to maintain multitarget cleave.


**Row 8**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/achievement_arena_2v2_5.gif)Raging Armaments](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=388049/raging-armaments) \- minor mastery buff, with a very important Enrage extension, which helps keep Bloodthirst active in the rotation.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_rogue_sprint.gif)Swift Strikes](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=383459/swift-strikes) \- a minor haste buff, with a small rage generation increase which adds up significantly over the course of a dungeon or encounter.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_criticalstrike.gif)Critical Thinking](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=383297/critical-thinking) \- a minor critical strike buff, with a small critical strike damage buff which is of much greater value in combination with Reckless Abandon.


**Row 9**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_trauma.gif)Onslaught](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=315720/onslaught) (Ons) - a moderately strong standalone attack, which helps fill extra GCDs in the rotation.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_angermanagement.gif)Anger Management](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=152278/anger-management) (AM) - reduces Recklessness down to an average of 45-50s cooldown, aligning rather well with Odyn's Fury.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_incinerate.gif)Reckless Abandon](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=396749/reckless-abandon) (RA) - causes Bloodthirst and Raging Blow to be replaced by stronger versions - Bloodbath and Crushing Blow, creating a powerful gameplay loop.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_bladestorm.gif)Bladestorm](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=227847/bladestorm) (BS) - the premier multitarget damage ability, which has a reduced 4s duration and quickly generates a very large amount of rage for Fury.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_ravager.gif)Ravager](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=228920/ravager) (Rav) - strong passive damage alternative to Bladestorm, more suitable against single targets.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_sword_1h_artifactvigfus_d_01.gif)Odyn's Fury](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=385059/odyns-fury) (OF) - a very powerful burst damage attack with a short lingering bleed.


**Row 10**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_mace_1h_blacksmithing_b_01_black.gif)Tenderize](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=388933/tenderize) \- greatly increases the value of Onslaught, both in jumpstarting the rotation and increasing the damage of Rampage.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_spectralsight.gif)Unhinged](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=386628/unhinged) \- provides a deceptively powerful bonus to both single and multitarget damage during either Bladestorm or Ravager.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_creature_cursed_04.gif)Storm of Steel](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=382953/storm-of-steel) \- gives Ravager a second charge, which is fairly important in most content.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_endlessrage.gif)Unbridled Ferocity](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=389603/unbridled-ferocity) \- randomly triggers Recklessness, though its low proc chance leaves it generally uncompetitive.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/racial_troll_berserk.gif)Depths of Insanity](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=383922/depths-of-insanity) \- generally uncompetitive, due to its small impact on overall uptime.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_sword_1h_artifactvigfus_d_01dual.gif)Dancing Blades](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=391683/dancing-blades) \- triggers a large auto-attack buff, which provides a bonus to Odyn's Fury's single target value.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_sword_1h_artifactvigfus_d_02.gif)Titanic Rage](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=394329/titanic-rage) \- a minor damage buff, but jumpstarts the AoE rotation by auto-applying important buffs, with even greater synergy in combination with Titan's Torment.

# Fury Warrior Stat Priority - Midnight

[By Archimtiros](https://www.wowhead.com/author/Archimtiros)
Updated:
2026/02/25

Stats are a key component of customizing your Fury Warrior in Midnight. Having the right distribution of stats on your gear can be critical towards optimizing your performance.

This guide details the best stat priority for your Fury Warrior, as well as covering how to determine Fury Warrior stat priorities personalized for your character in **Midnight Season 1**, as well as how to check whether an item Best-in-Slot, an upgrade, or outright bad.

It also covers Fury Warrior's preferred stats in-depth, accounting for nuances and synergies for niche situations that go beyond a generic priority.

[Overview](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/fury/overview-pve-dps) [BiS Gear](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/fury/bis-gear) [Rotation](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/fury/rotation-cooldowns-pve-dps) [Talent Builds](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/fury/talent-builds-pve-dps) [Consumables](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/fury/enchants-gems-pve-dps) [Stats](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/fury/stat-priority-pve-dps) [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/large/inv_misc_groupneedmore.jpg)\\
Basics](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/fury/basics)

Show Table of Contents

## ~~~~ Best Stats for Fury Warrior

Both Mountain Thane and Slayer Fury Warrior stat priorities emphasize weapon damage and Strength (via item level), along with Haste and Mastery. Secondary stats can vary greatly depending on the player's level of gear, however, as the value of heavily stacked stats tends to drop as you gear beyond the point of [diminishing returns](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/diminishing-returns-on-secondary-stats-in-world-of-warcraft). The choice between [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_unholyfrenzy.gif)Frenzied Enrage](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=383848/frenzied-enrage) and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_strengthofarms.gif)Powerful Enrage](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=440277/powerful-enrage) will also affect the long-term value greatly.

**Mountain Thane Stat Priority**

1. Strength

2. Haste

3. Mastery

4. Critical Strike

5. Versatility


**Slayer Stat Priority**

1. Strength

2. Haste

3. Mastery

4. Critical Strike

5. Versatility


**Keep in mind that these values fluctuate heavily and the best gear actually available to you may not meet these ideals.**

Choosing between different pieces of gear provides an opportunity to customize stats. Following the suggestions below, we've tailored recommendations of best-in-slot gear to pursue during **Midnight Season 1** for Fury Warriors in our Gearing Guide.

[![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/inv_chest_chain_03.jpg)Fury Warrior Gearing Guide](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/fury/bis-gear)

## ~~~~ Stats Explained

**Strength** is a Warrior's primary stat, increasing all damage done by native class spells, abilities, and auto attacks. Previously one of the weakest stats, but now much more impactful, making raw item level very important.

- **Haste**: Compresses the rotation by reducing both the GCD and the cooldown of rotational abilities: Bloodthirst, Raging Blow, and Execute. Often a priority for very early gearing in The War Within, it tends to fall in value fairly quickly.

- **Critical Strike**: Increases damage done by abilities, auto attacks, and trinkets. While some talents, legendaries, and covenant abilities interact with critical strikes, the stat's value is rather low and better avoided.

- **Mastery**: Increases the damage bonus of [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_endlessrage.gif)Mastery: Unshackled Fury](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=76856/mastery-unshackled-fury). It does not affect non-class damage, such as trinkets, potions, and enchantments.

- **Versatility**: Increases damage done and reduces damage taken by half the amount. Unlike Mastery, however, it affects all damage done including trinkets, potions, and enchantments.


## ~~~~ Sim Your Enhacement Shaman

The suggestions for stat priorities mentioned above are generic; exact values will change based on your gear. To gain a proper understanding of your optimal stats, we recommend **simming your character** using various tools available in the community, such as [SimulationCraft](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/how-to-use-simulationcraft-and-pawn-4885). You can easily sim your character and identify your stat priority with Raidbots, an online platform! ## ~~~~ Diminishing Returns in Midnight

Accumulating too much of one Secondary stat from your gear leads to diminishing returns. This means that adding more of the same stat beyond certain thresholds results in reduced benefits. These thresholds are fixed and reduce the amount gained from more of that stat rating by 10% per breakpoint. Each stat has a different rating threshold where the reduction begins:

- **Critical Strike** \- Above 1380 rating

- **Haste** \- Above 1320 rating

- **Mastery** \- Above 1380 rating

- **Versatility** \- Above 1620 rating


**Example**

Let's assume you gain 1% Haste for 10 Haste Rating. When above the diminishing return breakpoint, 10 Haste Rating would give you 0.9% Haste instead, resulting in a 10% reduction from what you gained previously.

Note that this system **only counts stat rating**, meaning that percentage-based procs and effects like [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_nature_bloodlust.gif)Bloodlust](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=2825/bloodlust) aren't factored in and will always grant their full benefit.

You can learn more about stat diminishing returns in our detailed guide:

[What are Stat Diminishing Returns](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/diminishing-returns-on-secondary-stats-in-world-of-warcraft)

| --- | --- |
| Fury Warriors revolve around maximizing [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_unholyfrenzy.gif)Enrage](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=184361/enrage) uptime and dealing damage through fast-paced attacks and a variety of special abilities, excelling at dealing high multitarget damage while sacrificing little to no single target to do so.

* * *

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| ~~~~ | **Avoid Downtime** \- Fury generates the majority of its rage from abilities, so reducing the amount of time spent chasing, running out mechanics, or otherwise not hitting the boss is critical to maximizing performance. There are several abilities to help with this, such as [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_charge.gif)Charge](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=100/charge) and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_heroicleap.gif)Heroic Leap](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=6544/heroic-leap), so use them smartly to stay on target as much as possible! |

* * *

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| ~~~~ | **Keep Abilities on cooldown** \- nearly every rotational Fury ability generates rage, though only [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_rampage.gif)Rampage](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=184367/rampage) spends it, and in large amounts. This makes it very important to ensure that abilities are constantly being used to ensure that [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_unholyfrenzy.gif)Enrage](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=184361/enrage) is constantly maintained. |

* * *

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| ~~~~ | **Avoid wasting Rage** \- unlike most resources, rage starts from zero and decays out of combat. Making efficient use of it, both in combat and by reducing the amount of time spent moving from one combat to another, will help maintain the rotation and eliminate downtime spent waiting for more resources. | | |

* * *

**Reading Priority Lists**

Abilities and talents are listed from highest to lowest priority in the Fury Warrior rotation. Every time an ability is cast, begin again at the top of the list and move down until there is something that can be cast, then return to the top once more.

Sudden Death also now triggers Reap the Storm, giving it a very high priority in multitarget.

Before any form of combat, whether raids, dungeons, delves, or even open-world content, ensure that [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_battleshout.gif)Battle Shout](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=6673/battle-shout) is active on yourself and all relevant party members. In higher-end content, applying a food buff, flask, weapon oils, and preparing a combat potion is also a good idea.

- **Be in Berserker Stance**

- **Apply Battle Shout**

- **Eat food, drink flask**

- **Apply weapon oils, use augment rune as needed**

Avatar
