Increases rage generation to enable much more regular use of Rampage, further enhanced by the apex talent [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv12_apextalent_warrior_rampagingberserker2.gif)Rampaging Berserker](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1269309/rampaging-berserker). With its cooldown reduced by [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_angermanagement.gif)Anger Management](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=152278/anger-management) and aligning perfectly with [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_avatar.gif)Avatar](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=107574/avatar), it should have a fairly high uptime over the course of a dungeon or encounter.

A basic damage increase, this is a much more important cooldown for Mountain Thane, due to the influence of [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_racial_avatar.gif)Storm Surge](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=275336/storm-surge), [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/achievement_dungeon_blackrockcaverns_ascendantlordobsidius.gif)Avatar of the Storm](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=437134/avatar-of-the-storm), and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_nature_purge.gif)Capacitance](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1270724/capacitance). It should align perfectly with Recklessness and may therefore be macroed together, though Slayer will instead talent into Bladestorm.

A secondary cooldown used exclusively by Slayer, it deals a good amount of single and multitarget damage, while also triggering supplementary effects such as [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_butcher_exsanguination.gif)Violent Euphoria](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1270717/violent-euphoria) and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_spectralsight.gif)Unhinged](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=386628/unhinged). It has a unique form of cooldown reduction, so it will not always align with other cooldowns, making it important to think about when to use the cooldown and when to save it.

A talented AoE attack and the focus of Midnight's first seasonal tier set. Dealing a good amount of single and multitarget damage, it also automatically triggers enrage, making it a good initiator.

A talented attack in the class tree, which serves more of a utility role in keeping enemies within an area, though its damage is rather mediocre. The ability can be reactivated to leap to the spear, though this has very niche applications.

## ~~~~ Fury Warrior Advanced Tips

Maximizing Uptime

Aligning Cooldowns

Fury Warriors are very straightforward damage dealers, with a very flat damage profile not concentrated entirely into cooldown windows. Because of this, the biggest optimization is simply maximizing uptime on the target - knowing what mechanics are coming _before_ they actually happen will help plan movement to minimize time spent off target, allowing more rage to be generated and more GCDs to be fit into the overall rotation.

There are a variety of tools to help with this, from using [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_heroicleap.gif)Heroic Leap](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=6544/heroic-leap) to move out of range at the last moment before damage goes out, to using [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_charge.gif)Charge](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=100/charge) after a target has finished moving, which are largely a byproduct of time and experience.

Fury Warriors have several cooldowns, but they're all used more or less the same way - on cooldown as much as possible. When situations or timers allow, cooldowns can be aligned, but they should not be delayed by a significant amount (typically no less than 10-15% of their actual cooldown) unless the delay will allow them to hit multiple targets when they would otherwise hit one, or it will be your final use of the cooldown before the end of the fight regardless.

The reason is that losing an entire use of a cooldown is typically a bigger loss than what is gained by stacking the cooldown with something else to amplify it. Some cooldowns, like [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_innerrage.gif)Recklessness](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1719/recklessness) and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_avatar.gif)Avatar](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=107574/avatar) will always align naturally, though others will not, so anticipating those timers and knowing when adds or important damage phases are coming is key.

# Fury Warrior Enchants & Consumables - Midnight

[By Archimtiros](https://www.wowhead.com/author/Archimtiros)
Updated:
2026/03/16

Consumables are an important aspect of high-level content in WoW, such as raids and Mythic+ dungeons. They provide additional ways for players to improve and customize their stats outside of gear.

In this guide, we will explain the best gems, flasks, potions, and enchants to use for Fury Warrior in **Midnight Season 1**, as well as cheaper alternatives. Make sure to also check our [Midnight Profession Guide](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/professions/overview) for all profession details.

### Fury Warrior Gems

The [![Indecipherable Eversong Diamond](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_jewelcrafting_epic_gem_cut_green.gif)Indecipherable Eversong Diamond![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=240983/indecipherable-eversong-diamond) is generally stronger than [![Powerful Eversong Diamond](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_jewelcrafting_epic_gem_cut_orange.gif)Powerful Eversong Diamond![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=240967/powerful-eversong-diamond), which removes the need to micromanage gem colors. Simply fill any extra slots with either [![Flawless Quick Amethyst](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_jewelcrafting_rare_gem_cut_nature_purple.gif)Flawless Quick Amethyst![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=240900/flawless-quick-amethyst) or [![Flawless Masterful Peridot](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_jewelcrafting_rare_gem_cut_void_green.gif)Flawless Masterful Peridot![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=240892/flawless-masterful-peridot).

These are the best flasks, potions, food, and other enhancements for Fury Warriors in PvE content. Please note that stats are flexible and may change according to your current gearing. Once your gear is stabilized, you should ideally be simming your character using [raidbots](https://www.raidbots.com/simbot) to determine the best configuration for you.

|     |     |     |

| Combat Potion | [![Potion of Recklessness](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_alchemy_voidpotion_red.gif)Potion of Recklessness![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241288/potion-of-recklessness) | [![Potion of Recklessness](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_alchemy_voidpotion_red.gif)Potion of Recklessness![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241288/potion-of-recklessness) |

### Fury Warrior Flasks

The best flask for Fury Warriors is [![Flask of the Magisters](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_alchemy_flask_sindoreipotion_black.gif)Flask of the Magisters![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241322/flask-of-the-magisters) or [![Flask of the Blood Knights](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_alchemy_flask_sindoreipotion_white-.gif)Flask of the Blood Knights![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241324/flask-of-the-blood-knights).

### Fury Warrior Combat Potion

[![Potion of Recklessness](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_alchemy_voidpotion_red.gif)Potion of Recklessness![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241288/potion-of-recklessness) is the best combat potion in all content for Fury Warriors, though [![Potion of Recklessness](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_alchemy_voidpotion_red.gif)Potion of Recklessness![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241288/potion-of-recklessness) is a very close alternative. [![Draught of Rampant Abandon](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_alchemy_voidpotion_purple.gif)Draught of Rampant Abandon![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241292/draught-of-rampant-abandon) can be powerful, but the frequent need to move to avoid being silenced makes it weaker in practice.

### Fury Warrior Health Potion

[![Silvermoon Health Potion](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_alchemy_lightpotion_orange.gif)Silvermoon Health Potion![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=241304/silvermoon-health-potion) is the best healing potion in The War Within.

### Fury Warrior Weapon Buff

Fury Warriors should apply [![Thalassian Phoenix Oil](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_12_profession_enchanting_manaoil_red.gif)Thalassian Phoenix Oil![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/TextureAtlas/live/professions-chaticon-quality-tier2.png)](https://www.wowhead.com/item=243734/thalassian-phoenix-oil) to both of their weapons.

### Fury Warrior Augment Rune

[![Void-Touched Augment Rune](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_10_enchanting_crystal_color2.gif)Void-Touched Augment Rune](https://www.wowhead.com/item=259085/void-touched-augment-rune) is the only new Augment Rune in The War Within.

### Fury Warrior Food

[![Blooming Feast](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_misc_food_cooked_greatpabanquet_wok.gif)Blooming Feast](https://www.wowhead.com/item=242273/blooming-feast), [![Champion's Bento](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_misc_food_vendor_poundedricecake_1.gif)Champion's Bento](https://www.wowhead.com/item=242274/champions-bento), and [![Flora Frenzy](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_cooking_100_sidesalad_color04.gif)Flora Frenzy](https://www.wowhead.com/item=255848/flora-frenzy) all provide the maximum benefit.

As a spec, Protection focuses on dealing direct damage coupled with Bleed applications for passive damage output. Our defensive capabilities are tied to Block, which is arguably one of the most powerful defensive mechanics in the game. We can sometimes even block magic attacks, thus reducing our damage intake by a significant amount. ## Protection Warrior Strengths and Weaknesses | | | | | --- | --- | --- | | **Strengths** | | **Weaknesses** | | - Strong offensive cooldowns that can be used frequently.

- Short cooldowns on most defensive abilities, which can cover a lot of mechanics if spaced out correctly.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_heroicleap.gif)Heroic Leap](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=6544/heroic-leap) and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_charge.gif)Charge](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=100/charge) provide excellent mobility.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_defend.gif)Shield Block](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=2565/shield-block) is the single most overpowered form of mitigation in the game. Blood Death Knights hate you for it!

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_shieldreflection.gif)Spell Reflection](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=23920/spell-reflection) allows you to turn your weaknesses into your strengths in Mythic+.

- The spec brings excellent defensive consistency. Maintaining 100% [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_defend.gif)Shield Block](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=2565/shield-block) uptime is possible, which allows for smooth damage intake. | | - Susceptible to damage spikes if you let [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_defend.gif)Shield Block](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=2565/shield-block) fall off or turn your back to enemies.

- Self-healing does not scale with damage taken in the same way as it does for Vengeance Demon Hunters or Blood Death Knights.

- Managing defensive cooldowns can take a high degree of skill, awareness, and encounter knowledge.

- The spec is weak against unblockable/non-reflectable damage, such as frequent DoTs. While Mountain Thane focuses on harnessing the power of lightning, Colossus focuses on the raw power of your own muscles to deal considerable amounts of damage. With current balancing, the overall flow, rotational speed, and Rage generation of Mountain Thane tend to outshine Colossus. It is also worth noting that the tree is favored from a defensive standpoint. Colossus plays with a slower rotation, which might feel better or worse depending on player preference. Both Hero trees are competitive with one another in terms of damage output and utility. Mountain Thane also brings the addition of [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_winston_bubble.gif)Storm Shield](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=438597/storm-shield), which can be extremely useful in Mythic+ and raids alike. Colossus offers a significant buff to [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_shockwave.gif)Shockwave](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=46968/shockwave) in the form of a choice node between [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shaman_earthquake.gif)Earthquaker](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=440992/earthquaker) and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_deathknight_brittlebones.gif)Boneshaker](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=429639/boneshaker), as well as considerably higher AoE damage output. Towards this goal, we follow a handful of simple rules. | | | | --- | --- | | ~~~~ | **React to Shield Slam procs:** This is one of your higher priorities. The [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_shield_05.gif)Strategist](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=384041/strategist) talent allows several abilities to reset the cooldown of [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_shield_05.gif)Shield Slam](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=23922/shield-slam), while [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_sword_11.gif)Devastator](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=236279/devastator) accomplishes the same with auto-attacks. | * * * | | | | --- | --- | | ~~~~ | **Avoid Rage waste:** As it is our goal to generate as much [![Rage](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_misc_emotionangry.gif)Rage](https://www.wowhead.com/resource/rage-1) as possible, it is also only natural to want to spend said Rage without wasting any of it. This means having to balance Rage spending to the point where you can avoid running dry while also avoiding Rage overcap. Abilities such as [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_sword_48.gif)Execute](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=163201/execute), [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_revenge.gif)Revenge](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=6572/revenge), and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_renewedvigor.gif)Ignore Pain](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=190456/ignore-pain) provide ways to make efficient use of Rage. | * * * | | | | --- | --- | | ~~~~ | **Use cooldowns on cooldown!:** As we have an array of offensive cooldowns on our hands, it is vital to use them as often as possible to further maximize both damage output and Rage generation! | [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/spell_mekkatorque_bot_bluegear.jpg)Rotation](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/protection/rotation-cooldowns-pve-tank) [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/inv_112_achievement_raid_manaforgeomega.jpg)Raid Tips](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/protection/manaforge-omega-raid-tips) [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/inv_relics_hourglass.jpg)Mythic+](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/protection/mythic-plus-dungeon-tips) ## ~~~~ Gearing a Protection Warrior in Midnight Season 1 Item level is often more important than optimized Secondary stats, as it gives more Health, Strength, and armor. Having too low haste is very noticeable, and as such, I would potentially drop ilevel if your haste is getting to extremely low levels, to attain better amounts of it. This is especially important for jewelry pieces, as they don't have armor or Strength. Haste is almost always the most important stat for a Protection Warrior for both damage and survivability; therefore, you will see the gearing choices tailored towards that. You should always use [Raidbots](https://www.raidbots.com/simbot/stats) to sim your character since every character is different. [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/inv_chest_chain_03.jpg)Best-in-Slot Gear](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/protection/bis-gear) ## ~~~~ What Professions are Best for Protection Warrior? Compared to previous expansions, professions in Midnight provide minimal benefits towards the performance of your spec. This means that Protection Warrior players can choose any profession according to personal preference. You might consider [Blacksmithing](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/midnight/professions/blacksmithing-overview-trainer-locations-recipes-tools) to craft your own armor, as many profession items can be very close to your [Best in Slot gear](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/protection/bis-gear). On the other hand, you may opt for [Alchemy](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/midnight/professions/alchemy-overview-trainer-locations-recipes-tools) to craft consumables or [Enchanting](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/midnight/professions/enchanting-overview-trainer-locations-recipes-tools) to enchant gear without relying on the Auction House. [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/inv_inscription_80_warscroll_intellect.jpg)Stats](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/protection/stat-priority-pve-tank) [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/ui_concentration.jpg)Professions in Midnight](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/professions/overview) ## ~~~~ What Race is Best for Protection Warrior? Below, you'll find the recommended races for each faction. These options excel in specific niches, though you can technically play any race option and succeed. - **Alliance:** [Dwarf](https://www.wowhead.com/dwarf) grants a decent amount of damage through [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_hammer_05.gif)Might of the Mountain](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=59224/might-of-the-mountain), which is quite potent for us. It also has great utility, as you can use [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shadow_unholystrength.gif)Stoneform](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=20594/stoneform) to remove Curses or Magic effects that you can't remove normally. Stoneform also provides 10% Physical damage reduction. This can be quite useful in Mythic+, certain raid encounters, and PvP when used correctly. - **Horde:** [Tauren](https://www.wowhead.com/tauren) also grants damage through [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_misc_head_tauren_01.gif)Brawn](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=154743/brawn). It also has great utility through [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warstomp.gif)War Stomp](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=20549/war-stomp), which can be a useful stun for stopping mobs in Mythic+ or even certain raid encounters. [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_nature_unyeildingstamina.gif)Endurance](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=20550/endurance) provides a small amount of stamina increase, which is quite nice defensively. Out of the choice between Dwarf and Tauren, I will personally recommend Dwarf due to the sheer amount of bleeds or curses and magic effects you can remove with Stoneform. However, if you do not want to play Alliance, Tauren s an absolutely solid and competitive option. * * * Our Protection Warrior guides are always updated with the latest information from in-game experience, simulations, and logs. Make sure to check our changelog for this page by clicking on **View Changelog** in the Quick Facts column or on the book icon at the top of the page. If you are interested in more in-depth Protection Warrior guides for **Midnight Season 1**, make sure to browse the _Navigation Bar_ at the top of the page. * * * ## Feedback Thanks for reading our class guides! If you have any feedback, feel free to leave a comment in the section below, and we will reply as quickly as possible. If you'd like to talk with any of our writers directly, you can do so by joining our [Discord server](http://discord.gg/wowhead) and finding them there! ![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/author-pages/author/default-live.png) ## Pumps ### World of Warcraft Guardian Druid Expert [Twitch](https://www.twitch.tv/Pumpsm8)[Author Page](https://www.wowhead.com/author/Pumps) Pumps is the GM of the highest ranked raiding Oceanic guild, , on US-Frostmourne and has been writing guides for over 10 years. ## ~~~~ Rotation Priority for Protection Warrior Beginners

This is a simple example of the spell priorities that make up the Protection Warrior rotation. More information about the rotation, as well as an explanation of important abilities and advanced tips can be found in the [Protection Warrior Rotation Guide](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/protection/rotation-cooldowns-pve-tank).

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| |     |     |
| --- | --- |
| ~~~~ | **Shield Slam:** This is one of your higher priorities. The [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_shield_05.gif)Strategist](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=384041/strategist) talent allows several abilities to reset the cooldown of [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_shield_05.gif)Shield Slam](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=23922/shield-slam), while [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_sword_11.gif)Devastator](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=236279/devastator) accomplishes the same with auto-attacks. |

* * *

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| ~~~~ | **Ignore Pain:** Utilizing this often will provide ways to make efficient use of Rage. |

* * *

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| ~~~~ | **Thunder Clap:** Keeping this on cooldown and making use of any empowered procs we get is integral for Mountain Thane especially. | |

### Single Button Rotation Assistant

Assisted Highlight and Single-Button Assistant are two new tools designed to assist players with general combat rotation and how their class spells and abilities influence one another. For Protection Warrior, these tools are fairly inadequate. They can be a good stepping stone as you are first learning but you should ideally aim to disable them as quickly as possible.

## ~~~~ Best Stats for Protection Warrior Beginners

For secondary stats, each stat does the following. Every stat has offensive and defensive value, which will be described below.

- **Haste** reduces the global cooldown, which increases Rage generation, DPS, and damage reduction with [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_renewedvigor.gif)Ignore Pain](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=190456/ignore-pain). It also increases the availability of [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_defend.gif)Shield Block](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=2565/shield-block). It is the best secondary stat, hands-down.

- **Versatility** is a plain increase in damage done and damage reduction. It increases Equipment damage, including Trinkets and special weapons! A good stat all around.

- **Critical Strike** is a great DPS stat. In M+ specifically, it gets a lot of traction defensively because of the sheer amount of melee attacks being thrown at you, and oftentimes can parry dangerous tank busters or prevent certain debuff applications entirely. You should, however, not plan around this happening. As only a fool relies on chance.

- **Mastery** increases both the chance to critically block and base block chance. This increases overall damage mitigation. The main shortcoming is that it doesn't directly improve your damage reduction against unblockable sources (such as spell damage or DoTs/Bleeds) -- although it does increase your Attack Power, which makes [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_renewedvigor.gif)Ignore Pain](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=190456/ignore-pain) stronger.


For more details, check our [Protection Warrior Stats guide](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/protection/stat-priority-pve-tank).

# Protection Warrior Abilities and Talents Guide - Midnight

[By Pumps](https://www.wowhead.com/author/Pumps)
Updated:
2026/02/25

LivePumps[Live on Twitch!](https://www.twitch.tv/pumpsm8) Offline on TwitchFollow: Follow [Twitch](https://www.twitch.tv/pumpsm8)

Explore the depths of the Protection Warrior talent tree, which contains the bulk of your abilities and customization options. In this Protection Warrior guide, we review all the different abilities and talents in **Midnight Season 1**, including an explanation for what they do and how to use them correctly.

[Overview](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/protection/overview-pve-tank) [BiS Gear](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/protection/bis-gear) [Rotation](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/protection/rotation-cooldowns-pve-tank) [Talent Builds](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/protection/talent-builds-pve-tank) [Consumables](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/protection/enchants-gems-pve-tank) [Stats](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/protection/stat-priority-pve-tank) [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/large/inv_misc_groupneedmore.jpg)\\
Basics](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/protection/basics)

## ~~~~ Baseline Protection Warrior Spells

### Offensive Abilities

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_shield_05.gif)Shield Slam](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=23922/shield-slam) ( **SS**)\- Your main offensive skill. Deals damage, generates Rage, it’s great.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_sword_11.gif)Devastate](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=20243/devastate) \- A very basic damaging skill that has a lot of talent interactions.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_sword_48.gif)Execute](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=163201/execute) \- Powerful single-target damage skill. Consumes lots of Rage to finish off low-health enemies.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_axe_66.gif)Heroic Throw](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=57755/heroic-throw) ( **HT**) \- Weak single-target damage skill. Useful for tagging enemies from range, that’s it.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_decisivestrike.gif)Slam](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1464/slam) \- A basic Rage-spending, single-target damage skill. It is not useful to Protection Warriors.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_whirlwind.gif)Whirlwind](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1680/whirlwind) ( **WW**) \- A basic Rage-spending, AoE damage skill. It is not useful to Protection Warriors.


### Utility Abilities

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_defend.gif)Shield Block](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=2565/shield-block) ( **SB**) \- Primary defensive skill. Very powerful damage mitigation while active.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_battleshout.gif)Battle Shout](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=6673/battle-shout) ( **BS or Shout**) \- Excellent attack power buff for your group.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_charge.gif)Charge](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=100/charge) \- Basic, excellent mobility skill. All Warriors have it, and it’s great.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_gauntlets_04.gif)Pummel](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=6552/pummel) ( **Kick**) \- Simple interrupt.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_nature_reincarnation.gif)Taunt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=355/taunt) \- Taunts enemies. Very basic.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_devastate.gif)Victory Rush](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=34428/victory-rush) ( **VR**) \- Self-heal that becomes active after securing a kill.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_shockwave.gif)Hamstring](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1715/hamstring) \- A single-target slow. Occasionally useful, but not very often.


### Passive Abilities

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_criticalblock.gif)Mastery: Critical Block](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=76857/mastery-critical-block) \- This is your Mastery. It reduces the damage taken from auto-attacks you block. It also increases your Attack Power. It’s okay.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_defend.gif)Shield Block](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=231847/shield-block) \- Grants your main defensive skill a second charge.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_sword_30.gif)Riposte](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=161798/riposte) \- A very simple Crit to Parry conversion.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_defensivestance.gif)Vanguard](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=71/vanguard) \- Simple defensive aura, reduces your damage taken, increases your Stamina and Armor.


## Protection Warrior Hero Talents

### Mountain Thane Protection Warrior Talents

**Key Talent**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_vehicle_electrocharge.gif)Lightning Strikes](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=434969/lightning-strikes) \- Damaging Enemies with [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_nature_thunderclap.gif)Thunder Clap](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=6343/thunder-clap), [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_revenge.gif)Revenge](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=6572/revenge) or [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_sword_48.gif)Execute](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=163201/execute) has a chance to deal extra damage.


**Capstone Talent**

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/achievement_dungeon_blackrockcaverns_ascendantlordobsidius.gif)Avatar of the Storm](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=437134/avatar-of-the-storm) \- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_avatar.gif)Avatar](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=107574/avatar) resets [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_nature_thunderclap.gif)Thunder Clap](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=6343/thunder-clap) and grants 2 charges of [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_bloodandthunder.gif)Thunder Blast](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=435607/thunder-blast). While [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_avatar.gif)Avatar](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=107574/avatar) is not active [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_vehicle_electrocharge.gif)Lightning Strikes](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=434969/lightning-strikes) has a 10% chance to grant 4 seconds of [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_avatar.gif)Avatar](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=107574/avatar).


**Choice Nodes**

- Choice Node 1:

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_thunderking_overcharge.gif)Keep Your Feet on the Ground](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=438590/keep-your-feet-on-the-ground) \- Reduces physical damage taken by 2% and enemies hit by [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_bloodandthunder.gif)Thunder Blast](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=435607/thunder-blast) deal 8% less damage to you for 5 seconds.

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_devastate.gif)Steadfast as the Peaks](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=434970/steadfast-as-the-peaks) \- Increases Stamina by 5%. Also causes [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_impending_victory.gif)Impending Victory](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=202168/impending-victory) to increase Maximum HP by 10% for 5 seconds. Any wasted healing instead heals 5 seconds later.


- Choice Node 2:

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_stormbolt.gif)Storm Bolts](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=436162/storm-bolts) \- Allows your [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_stormbolt.gif)Storm Bolt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=107570/storm-bolt) to hit 2 additional targets, however also increases the cooldown of [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_stormbolt.gif)Storm Bolt](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=107570/storm-bolt) by 10 seconds.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_1115_warrior_crushingblow.gif)Heavy Handed](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1235088/heavy-handed) \- Allows [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_sword_48.gif)Execute](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=163201/execute) to strike 2 additional targets for a reduced amount. Great for raiding and overall damage output!


#### Row 10 Talents

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_shieldcharge.gif)Shield Charge](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=385952/shield-charge) ( **SC**) \- Decent offensive cooldown and Rage generation tool. It is not great on its own, but it is good with the talent synergy below. Grants 20 rage. It deals slightly more single-target damage than Ravager, but less AoE damage.

- [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_endlessrage.gif)Battle-Scarred Veteran](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=386394/battle-scarred-veteran) ( **BSV**) \- Reactive defensive cooldown that provides a ton of damage reduction and increased healing taken. The 3-minute cooldown is long. After FINALLY being fixed in 10.2.7, this Talent is properly useful for new players and may have niche applications in high keys as a planned defensive. Great tool to recover from a mistake or generally when in trouble.

- Choice Node between: [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_ravager.gif)Whirling Blade](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1235113/whirling-blade)/ [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_ravager.gif)Ravager](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=228920/ravager). [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_ravager.gif)Whirling Blade](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1235113/whirling-blade) for more overall damage. [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_ravager.gif)Ravager](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=228920/ravager) for a more controlled, predictable offensive cooldown.


  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_ravager.gif)Whirling Blade](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1235113/whirling-blade) \- This talent randomly sends out more frequent and shorter versions of [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_ravager.gif)Ravager](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=228920/ravager).

  - [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_ravager.gif)Ravager](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=228920/ravager) \- Great offensive Ability for initial threat in a pull, grants 60 rage over its course to help you stabilize and get the "Rage Feedback Machine" going.

Having the right distribution of stats on your gear can be critical towards optimizing your performance. This guide details the best stat priority for your Protection Warrior, as well as covering how to determine Protection Warrior stat priorities personalized for your character in **Midnight Season 1**, as well as how to check whether an item Best-in-Slot, an upgrade, or outright bad. It also covers Protection Warrior's preferred stats in-depth, accounting for nuances and synergies for niche situations that go beyond a generic priority. [Overview](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/protection/overview-pve-tank) [BiS Gear](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/protection/bis-gear) [Rotation](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/protection/rotation-cooldowns-pve-tank) [Talent Builds](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/protection/talent-builds-pve-tank) [Consumables](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/protection/enchants-gems-pve-tank) [Stats](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/protection/stat-priority-pve-tank) [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/large/inv_misc_groupneedmore.jpg)\\ Basics](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/protection/basics) Show Table of Contents ## ~~~~ Best Stats for Protection Warrior Defensively, Protection prefers Haste and Crit with a good balance of Vers and Mastery. Haste speeds up your rotation and Rage generation, while Crit grants a ton of parry for large pulls, which heavily reduces damage taken. Offensively, all 4 Secondary stats are fairly close, and your preferred stats can vary heavily based on your current stat allocation. If you have exceptionally low amounts of Critical Strike or an exceptionally high amount of Haste, Critical Strike may be stronger than Haste for you. | | | | --- | --- | | **Survivability Stat Priority**

2. **Haste**

5. **Mastery** | While not unlimited, gearing provides considerable freedom when customizing stats. Following the suggestions below, we've tailored recommendations of best-in-slot gear to seek during **Midnight Season 1** for Protection Warrior in our Gearing Guide. [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/inv_chest_chain_03.jpg)Protection Warrior Gearing Guide](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/warrior/protection/bis-gear) ## ~~~~ Stats Explained There are many important stats for Protection Warriors. All gear has an item level that dictates the "power" of the item. As the item level increases, they get more powerful. Item-level requirements for content usually increase as content becomes more difficult. ### Item Level Summary The following stats are increased with item level: - **Strength** gives parry chance against melee swings, increases the armor gain from [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_defensivestance.gif)Vanguard](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=71/vanguard), and attack power, which scales the power of abilities. - **Armor** reduces the damage you take from most physical non-bleed damage sources. Protection Warrior has several armor multipliers that make armor from gear more effective. - **Stamina** increases your raw health pool. - **Block** reduces the damage you take from attacks that you blocked. The only place to find this stat is the Shield slot. - **Secondary stats** \- most items have two secondary stats, but there are exceptions. ### Secondary Stats Summary For secondary stats, each stat does the following. Every stat has offensive and defensive value, which will be described below. - **Haste** reduces the global cooldown, which increases Rage generation, DPS, and damage reduction with [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_renewedvigor.gif)Ignore Pain](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=190456/ignore-pain). It also increases the availability of [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_defend.gif)Shield Block](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=2565/shield-block). It is the best secondary stat, hands-down. - #1 stat overall. - **Versatility** is a plain increase in damage done and damage reduction. It increases Equipment damage, including Trinkets and special weapons! A good stat all around. - **Critical Strike** is a great DPS stat. In M+ specifically, it gets a lot of traction defensively because of the sheer amount of melee attacks being thrown at you, and oftentimes can parry dangerous tank busters or prevent certain debuff applications entirely. You should, however, not plan around this happening. As only a fool relies on chance. - **Mastery** increases both the chance to critically block and base block chance. This increases overall damage mitigation. The main shortcoming is that it doesn't directly improve your damage reduction against unblockable sources (such as spell damage or DoTs/Bleeds) -- although it does increase your Attack Power, which makes [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_renewedvigor.gif)Ignore Pain](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=190456/ignore-pain) stronger. ## ~~~~ Sim Your Protection Warrior The suggestions for stat priorities mentioned above are generic; exact values will change based on your gear. To gain a proper understanding of your optimal stats, we recommend **simming your character** using various tools available in the community, such as [SimulationCraft](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/how-to-use-simulationcraft-and-pawn-4885). You can easily sim your character and identify your stat priority with Raidbots, an online platform! Explore more about Raidbots in our [comprehensive guide](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/how-to-use-raidbots-and-run-character-simulations-6050). Note that simming your character is only appropriate for obtaining offensive information. There are far too many variables and differing metrics to take into account to obtain useful recommendations from simming for survivability. to diminishing returns. This means that adding more of the same stat beyond certain thresholds results in reduced benefits. These thresholds are fixed and reduce the amount gained from more of that stat rating by 10% per breakpoint. Each stat has a different rating threshold where the reduction begins: - **Critical Strike** \- Above 1380 rating - **Haste** \- Above 1320 rating - **Mastery** \- Above 1380 rating - **Versatility** \- Above 1620 rating **Example** Let's assume you gain 1% Haste for 10 Haste Rating. When above the diminishing return breakpoint, 10 Haste Rating would give you 0.9% Haste instead, resulting in a 10% reduction from what you gained previously. Note that this system **only counts stat rating**, meaning that percentage-based procs and effects like [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_nature_bloodlust.gif)Bloodlust](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=2825/bloodlust) aren't factored in and will always grant their full benefit. ## Protection Warrior Rotation in Midnight Season 1

The rotation for Protection Warrior is fast paced and fun. It has many frequent procs that always keep you on your toes.

We primarily focus on building and spending as much rage as possible to cycle our cooldowns faster.

|     |     |
| --- | --- |

## ~~~~ Protection Warrior Major Cooldowns

Protection Warrior has 3 main cooldowns they cycle offensively. [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/warrior_talent_icon_avatar.gif)Avatar](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=107574/avatar)/ [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_warcry.gif)Demoralizing Shout](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1160/demoralizing-shout) and [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_warrior_shieldcharge.gif)Shield Charge](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=385952/shield-charge). These are all to be used on cooldown as best as possible.

Avatar

Demo Shout

Shield Charge

### Avatar

Avatar gives you a multitude of perks and can be changed based on talents, but primary it increases all damage done and generally reduces the cooldown of Thunder Clap.

### Demo Shout

This both reduces the damage mobs deal to you and damage you deal to them alongside generating some rage.

### Shield Charge

Shield Charges grants you [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_defend.gif)Shield Block](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=2565/shield-block) and stuns the target.

## ~~~~ Protection Warrior Advanced Tips

Always Be Casting

### Always Be Casting

This is a classic staple for all specs in WoW, ABC. Always be casting. Your gcd usage is extremely important, if you are missing 10-20% of your total casts just because you aren't mashing fast enough then you are going to be losing a significant amount of damage and rage generation. This all plays into itself, less resources, less cdr, less damage when you need it.

Your casts don't have to be perfect all the time, just make sure you are actually hitting something instead of mashing buttons that aren't ready yet.

Having the right distribution of stats on your gear can be critical towards optimizing your performance. This guide details the best stat priority for your Elemental Shaman, as well as covering how to determine Elemental Shaman stat priorities personalized for your character in **Midnight Season 1**, as well as how to check whether an item Best-in-Slot, an upgrade, or outright bad. It also covers Elemental Shaman's preferred stats in-depth, accounting for nuances and synergies for niche situations that go beyond a generic priority. [Overview](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/shaman/elemental/overview-pve-dps) [BiS Gear](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/shaman/elemental/bis-gear) [Rotation](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/shaman/elemental/rotation-cooldowns-pve-dps) [Talent Builds](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/shaman/elemental/talent-builds-pve-dps) [Consumables](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/shaman/elemental/enchants-gems-pve-dps) [Stats](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/shaman/elemental/stat-priority-pve-dps) [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/large/inv_misc_groupneedmore.jpg)\\ Basics](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/shaman/elemental/basics) Show Table of Contents ## ~~~~ Best Stats for Elemental Shaman Stat priorities follow a very simple guideline: Get your Mastery to the first breakpoint at 72%, then split the rest of your secondary stat budget between Critical Strike and Haste. Try to avoid Versatility where possible. Some amount of Versatility is unavoidable because you will find it on tier pieces, so don't sweat if you have it on some random pieces. The other important guideline is that Mastery becomes pretty much useless after reaching 100%. While it is true that Mastery over 100% still increases damage done by a flat amount, the main benefit of the stat is in the overload, which are capped at 100%. With [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/shaman_talent_elementalblast.gif)Elemental Blast: Mastery](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=173184/elemental-blast-mastery) giving us 14% mastery, the usual "hardcap" for Mastery is at 86%. If you play the recommended Embellisment set [Root Warden's Regalia](https://www.wowhead.com/item-set=1967/root-wardens-regalia) this goes down even further to roughly 76%. Critical Strike has become significantly better in Midnight. With an even higher Critical Strike Multiplier thanks to [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv12_apextalent_shaman_feedbackloop.gif)Feedback Loop](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1270062/feedback-loop) stacking With [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shaman_lavaburst.gif)Lava Burst](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=51505/lava-burst) now scaling with your Critical Strike chance, its value has shot up massively. While still being behind Mastery, it has now caught up with Haste in Single Target. | | | | --- | --- | | **Farseer Stat Priority**

4. **Intellect** | While not unlimited, gearing provides considerable freedom when customizing stats. Following the suggestions below, we've tailored recommendations of best-in-slot gear to seek during **Midnight Season 1** for Elemental Shaman in our Gearing Guide. [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/medium/inv_chest_chain_03.jpg)Elemental Shaman Gearing Guide](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/classes/shaman/elemental/bis-gear) ## ~~~~ Stats Explained **Intellect** is your Primary stat, found on mail gear. It increases your Spell Power and damage/healing done with abilities. For Secondary stats, Elemental Shaman gains the following from each stat: - **Critical Strike**: Chance for attacks and heals to deal increased damage. Advanced Interactions Normally, a Critical Strike deals twice as much damage as a normal hit would. For Elemental Shamans this is further increased by 50% by [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_fire_volcano.gif)Elemental Fury](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=60188/elemental-fury), another 25% by [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_10_elementalshardfoozles_primordial.gif)Primordial Fury](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=378193/primordial-fury), another 50% with 2 points in [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv12_apextalent_shaman_feedbackloop.gif)Feedback Loop](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=1270062/feedback-loop), 5% for Nature spells from [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/ability_vehicle_electrocharge.gif)Stormcaller](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=454021/stormcaller) and lastly [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_shaman_lavaburst.gif)Lava Burst](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=51505/lava-burst), being a guaranteed crit, deals increased damage based on your crit chance. Racial bonuses like [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/inv_hammer_05.gif)Might of the Mountain](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=59224/might-of-the-mountain) can further increase this. - **Haste**: Increases cast speed, reduces your Global Cooldown, and reduces the cooldown of most rotational abilities. - **Mastery**: Increases the chance of [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_nature_lightningoverload.gif)Mastery: Elemental Overload](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=168534/mastery-elemental-overload), to trigger an "Overload" on some spells and increases all Elemental and Physical (i.e. all) damage done. - **Versatility**: Increases damage and healing, while also reducing damage taken. ## ~~~~ Sim Your Elemental Shaman The suggestions for stat priorities mentioned above are generic; exact values will change based on your gear. To gain a proper understanding of your optimal stats, we recommend **simming your character** using various tools available in the community, such as [SimulationCraft](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/how-to-use-simulationcraft-and-pawn-4885). You can easily sim your character and identify your stat priority with Raidbots, an online platform! to diminishing returns. This means that adding more of the same stat beyond certain thresholds results in reduced benefits. These thresholds are fixed and reduce the amount gained from more of that stat rating by 10% per breakpoint. Each stat has a different rating threshold where the reduction begins: - **Critical Strike** \- Above 1380 rating - **Haste** \- Above 1320 rating - **Mastery** \- Above 1380 rating - **Versatility** \- Above 1620 rating **Example** Let's assume you gain 1% Haste for 10 Haste Rating. When above the diminishing return breakpoint, 10 Haste Rating would give you 0.9% Haste instead, resulting in a 10% reduction from what you gained previously. Note that this system **only counts stat rating**, meaning that percentage-based procs and effects like [![](https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/tiny/spell_nature_bloodlust.gif)Bloodlust](https://www.wowhead.com/spell=2825/bloodlust) aren't factored in and will always grant their full benefit. You can learn more about stat diminishing returns in our detailed guide: [What are Stat Diminishing Returns](https://www.wowhead.com/guide/diminishing-returns-on-secondary-stats-in-world-of-warcraft) * * * Our Elemental Shaman guides are always updated with the latest information from in-game experience, simulations, and logs.
